ModerationEnableEditChange.description: If true, moderators are allowed to edit pending changes before approving. DANGEROUS: moderator can accidentally delete the text of pending change. Enable this only when you use Moderation for pre-publish review.

MultiPurgeCloudFlareCacheByDeviceType.description: Whether or not CloudFlare's cache by device type is enabled.

MultiPurgeEnabledServices.description: List of enabled services, e.g. [Varnish, Cloudflare]

MultiPurgeServiceOrder.description: Order of purge requests, e.g. [Varnish, Cloudflare]

MultiPurgeStaticPurges.description: Array of urls that can be purged using the special page. Key is displayed as the selection label.

MultiPurgeRunInQueue.description: Push purge jobs to the job queue instead of running it in sync.

PandocUltimateConverter.description: Pandoc extension which imports not only text, but also images

PandocUltimateConverter_PandocExecutable.description: Full path to pandoc library. No need to specify if pandoc is in PATH env variable

PandocUltimateConverter_TempFolderPath.description: Full path to temp folder where pandoc will unpack all the images. Will use system setting if not specified.

PandocUltimateConverter_MediaFileExtensi.description: Extensions speicified in this config, will be ignored during conversion -- media files will not be uploaded, but links to them will still exist in the converted doc

PandocUltimateConverter_PandocCustomUser.description: Specify custom user rights for this extension. See list here: https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:User_rights

PandocUltimateConverter_FiltersToUse.description: Array of custom filters which will be applied during conversion.

PandocUltimateConverter_UseColorProcesso.description: When true, use the ODT/DOCX color preprocessors to preserve text and background colours during conversion.

PandocUltimateConverter_PdfToHtmlExecuta.description: Full path to poppler's pdftohtml executable. No need to specify if pdftohtml is in PATH. Required for PDF import support.

PandocUltimateConverter_PdfToPpmExecutab.description: Full path to poppler's pdftoppm executable. No need to specify if pdftoppm is in PATH. Required for scanned PDF (OCR) support.

PandocUltimateConverter_PdfToTextExecuta.description: Full path to poppler's pdftotext executable. No need to specify if pdftotext is in PATH. Used to detect whether a PDF is text-based or scanned.

PandocUltimateConverter_LibreOfficeExecu.description: Full path to the LibreOffice executable (soffice or libreoffice). No need to specify if LibreOffice is in PATH. Required for .doc import support.

PandocUltimateConverter_PdfExportEngine.description: Engine used for PDF export. 'libreoffice' uses a two-step pipeline (Pandoc→DOCX→PDF via LibreOffice). Any other value (e.g. 'xelatex', 'pdflatex', 'lualatex', 'wkhtmltopdf', 'weasyprint') is passed directly to Pandoc's --pdf-engine option.

PandocUltimateConverter_TesseractExecuta.description: Full path to the tesseract OCR executable. No need to specify if tesseract is in PATH. Required for scanned PDF (OCR) support.

PandocUltimateConverter_OcrLanguage.description: Tesseract language code(s) used for OCR of scanned PDFs. Use '+' to combine multiple languages, e.g. 'eng+deu'. Defaults to 'eng'.

PandocUltimateConverter_ShowExportInPage.description: When true, show an 'Export' action in the page tools menu (Actions tab) on content pages.

PandocUltimateConverter_LlmProvider.description: LLM provider to use for optional wikitext cleanup. Supported values: 'openai' or 'claude'. Leave null to disable LLM polishing.

PandocUltimateConverter_LlmApiKey.description: API key for the configured LLM provider. Optional when LlmBaseUrl is set (e.g. unauthenticated self-hosted endpoints).

PandocUltimateConverter_LlmModel.description: Model name to use for LLM polishing. Defaults to 'gpt-5.4-nano' for OpenAI and 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022' for Claude. Should be set explicitly when using a custom LlmBaseUrl.

PandocUltimateConverter_LlmPrompt.description: Custom instruction prompt for the LLM cleanup step. Uses a sensible default if not set.

PandocUltimateConverter_LlmBaseUrl.description: Custom API endpoint URL that overrides the provider's default. Use this for self-hosted models (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio), Qwen/DashScope, OpenRouter, or any other OpenAI-compatible service. When set, LlmApiKey becomes optional.

PandocUltimateConverter_EnableConfluence.description: Set to false to disable the Special:ConfluenceMigration page and prevent any Confluence space migrations.

LstmapExpansionCompat.description: Use true to expand token and pattern variables only after token replacements in {{#lstmap}}. Use false to expand variables the same way as {{#listmap}}.

LstFunctionNamedExpansionCompat.description: Use 'old' to only allow numbered parameters in {{#lstfltr}}, {{#lstmap}}, {{#lstmaptemp}}, {{#lstrm}}, {{#lstsrt}}, and {{#lstuniq}}. PdfBookTab.description: Whether or not an action tab should be shown for printing to PDF

PdfBookDownload.description: Whether or not the files should be downloaded or viewed in-browser

PersistentPageIdentifiersFormat.description: The format to use when displaying persistent page identifiers. '$1' will be replaced with the actual identifier.

PlausibleHonorDNT.description: Honor the Do Not Track header and disable tracking

PlausibleTrackOutboundLinks.description: Enable Tracking of outbound link clicks

PlausibleTrackFileDownloads.description: Enable Tracking of link clicks that lead to files. This needs a custom event goal called 'File Download'.

PlausibleTrackFileDownloadExtensions.description: List of file extensions to additionally track, e.g. 'js'

PlausibleTrackLoggedIn.description: Enable Tracking for logged in users

PlausibleEnableTaggedEvents.description: Enable tracking clicks to tagged elements via css classes

PlausibleIgnoredTitles.description: List of page titles that should not be tracked

PlausibleTrackSearchInput.description: Send search form inputs to plausible

PlausibleTrackEditButtonClicks.description: Track clicks to the edit button

PlausibleTrack404.description: Tracks 404 pages. Does not actually check 404 responses, instead 404 = page is unknown.

PlausibleTrackNavplateClicks.description: Tracks clicks to links inside .navplate elements

PlausibleTrackInfoboxClicks.description: Tracks clicks to links inside .mw-capiunto-infobox and .infobox elements

PlausibleTrackCitizenSearchLinks.description: Track search link clicks. Only works with skin citizen.

PlausibleTrackCitizenMenuLinks.description: Track menu link clicks. Only works with skin citizen.

PlausibleApiKey.description: API Key used for querying statistics when Extension:PageViewInfo is active

PlausibleServerSideTracking.description: Server side events that get sent as custom events to plausible

RadyjonkaLinkedData.description: Linked data in an associative array.

RadyjonkaPWA.description: Use manifest.json and sw.js to create an PWA?

refreshInterval.description: Refreshing interval in seconds of RT users number displayed on a webpage.

RemovePIIAllowedWikis.description: Set to an array of database names of wikis which RemovePII can be initiated from. Wikis not in this array will have Special:RemovePII disabled. Leave it empty to enable it on all wikis.

RemovePIIHashPrefixOptions.description: Array of available hash prefix options that are selectable in Special:GenerateRandomHash.

RemovePIIHashPrefix.description: The default hash prefix to use when generating a hash through Special:GenerateRandomHash. Will be used when $wgRemovePIIHashPrefixOptions is empty.

RemovePIIAutoPrefix.description: The prefix to automatically use when using Special:RemovePII to remove personal identifiable information or rename a user. Automatically prepends, if using DPA validation this should be set, otherwise it will fail to validate.

RemovePIIDPAValidationEndpoint.description: Set to the full URL of an API to validate DPA IDs. {dpa_id} is replaced with the ID, and {username} is replaced with the old username. Leave as an empty string to disable validation.

RemoveRedLinksAlsoLoggedInUsers.description: Remove red links also for logged-in users, instead of only for unregistered users

RequestCustomDomainCloudflareConfig.description: Array. Cloudflare configuration array, including API Key and Zone ID.

RequestCustomDomainDisallowedDomains.description: Array. Domains that are not allowed to be requested via RequestCustomDomain.

RequestCustomDomainHelpUrl.description: Full URL. If set, adds a help URL to Special:RequestCustomDomain.

RequestCustomDomainSubdomain.description: String. The main part of default subdomains, e.g. wiki.example.org, example.org is the main part. Only necessary if used on a wiki farm. Only used to improve UI by adding a subdomain.tld inline form field hint.

RequestCustomDomainUsersNotifiedOnAllReq.description: Array of usernames to send email notifications to for all requests. Users listed here must have a verified email address on their account. This doesn't do anything if the Echo extension is not installed.

RichResults.description: Adds JSON-LD structured data for rich results

RobloxAPIAllowedArguments.description: The arguments per argument type that are allowed to be used in the extension. If empty, all arguments for the type are allowed.

RobloxAPICacheSplittingOptionalArguments.description: A list of optional arguments that affect caching.

RobloxAPICachingExpiries.description: The amount of seconds after the cache for a data source expires. '*' is a wildcard for all data sources.

RobloxAPIDataSourceUsageLimits.description: The maximum amount of times a data source can be used per page. If empty, no limit is applied.

RobloxAPIDisableCache.description: Whether or not to disable the cache for the extension.

RobloxAPIEnabledDatasources.description: The data sources that should be enabled and available.

RobloxAPIParserFunctionsExpensive.description: Whether or not to make the parser functions expensive.

RobloxAPIRegisterLegacyParserFunctions.description: Whether or not to register the legacy parser functions that became deprecated in v1.2.0.

RobloxAPIRequestUserAgent.description: The user agent that should be used when making requests to the Roblox API.

RobloxAPIShowPlainErrors.description: Whether errors should be shown as plain text instead of being rendered in an error box.

RottenLinksBadCodes.description: Array. Holds a list of HTTP codes that are considered bad.

RottenLinksCurlTimeout.description: Integer. Sets the timeout for cURL in seconds.

RottenLinksExcludeProtocols.description: Array. Holds a list of protocols that should not be checked for validity.

RottenLinksExcludeWebsites.description: Array. List of websites to exclude checking of response codes for.

RottenLinksExternalLinkTarget.description: String. Sets the external link target (_self for the current tab or _blank for a new tab).

RottenLinksHTTPProxy.description: String. Sets a proxy to use for requests.

RottenLinksUserAgent.description: String. Overrides the user-agent to use for requests. Defaults to 'RottenLinks, MediaWiki extension (https://github.com/miraheze/RottenLinks), running on <Wiki base URL>'.

seInterval.description: Interval in minutes for saving article backups.

seExpiration.description: Delete stored backups after this many hours.

seNamespaces.description: Namespaces where editor backups are enabled.

SaneCaseAutofixSpecialCharBreak.description: Tries to fix automatically cut URLs at the presence of special characters.

sblgBreadcrumbTrailStyleClass.description: Assigns a styling class to the breadcrumb trail

egSBLBreadcrumbDividerStyleClass.description: Assigns a divider styling class such as sbl-breadcrumb-pipe or sbl-breadcrumb-arrow

egSBLPropertySearchPatternByNamespace.description: An array of search patterns on a per-namespace basis; if no pattern is declared for a namespace then the search is disabled for it

egSBLTryToFindClosestDescendant.description: SBL will try to find the closest descendant (this does not work for subpages due to missing annotation information)

egSBLUseSubpageFinderFallback.description: SBL will try to match a hierarchy based on the Foo/Bar/Baz subpage notation when a property search returns empty results

egSBLPageTitleToHideSubpageParent.description: SBL will try to hide the parent part of a subpage title from display when a corresponding namespace entry is found in the wgNamespacesWithSubpages setting

egSBLEnabledSubpageParentAnnotation.description: Supports the auto-generation of Has parent page annotations for subpages

egSBLDisableTranslationSubpageAnnotation.description: Disables the annotation for a subpage when it is identified as a translation page

HttpResponseCacheLifetime.description: Specifies how long a response is cached before a new request is routed to the endpoint. This avoids that repeated requests with the same signature are made to an endpoint.

HttpResponseCacheType.description: Type of the cache to be used, using CACHE_NONE will disable the caching and reroutes every request to the endpoint.

ExternalRepositoryEndpoints.description: An array that identifies valid endpoints with a key expecting yo corresponds to an interwiki prefix. Details of that prefix can be either inserted directly into MediaWiki's interwiki table or through this setting.

ExternalRepositoryCredentials.description: An array that defines credentials to access remote wikis in case they're read-protected. Array keys should be named after interwiki prefixes from 'seqlgExternalRepositoryEndpoints' and contain an array with 'username' and 'password' keys

ExternalQueryEnabledNamespaces.description: An array defines list of namespaces allowed to execute queries against remote sources. Keep empty to allow every namespace.

UseFixedTables.description: To setup properties as fixed properties in order to improve data access

ExcludeBotEdits.description: Should edits via user accounts in usergroup "bot" be ignored when storing data for the special properties?

LinksToEnabledNamespaces.description: List of namespaces where the 'Links to' property should be enabled

CacheType.description: Cache used to improve query lookups. Defaults to CACHE_ANYTHING (-1).

EnabledCategoryFilterByLanguage.description: Enable language filtering on the category page.

AdminFeatures.description: Special:Admin feature flags. Array of any of: `refresh`, `setup`, `disposal`, `pstats`, `fullt`, `maintenance-script-docs`, `show-overview`, `alert-last-optimization-run`. Legacy `SMW_ADM_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

AllowRecursiveExport.description: When `true`, normal users can request recursive OWL/RDF exports.

AutoRefreshOnPageMove.description: When `true`, refreshes semantic data in the store when a page is moved.

AutoRefreshOnPurge.description: When `true`, refreshes semantic data in the store when a page is manually purged.

AutoRefreshSubject.description: When `true`, refreshes the semantic store for pages that are edited.

ChangePropagationProtection.description: When `true`, protects an active change propagation from being disabled without administrative intervention.

BrowseFeatures.description: Special:Browse feature flags. Array of any of: `toolbox-link`, `show-inverse`, `show-incoming`, `show-group`, `show-sortkey`, `use-api`. Legacy `SMW_BROWSE_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

CacheUsage.description: Defines time to live for in Semantic MediaWiki used cache instances.

ChangePropagationWatchlist.description: Property IDs that trigger full re-processing of dependent pages when their values change.

CategoryFeatures.description: Category feature flags. Array of any of: `redirect`, `instance`, `hierarchy`. Legacy `SMW_CAT_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

CheckForConstraintErrors.description: Property-constraint error checking. Accepts `false` (= `SMW_CONSTRAINT_ERR_CHECK_NONE`, off), `"check/main"` (= `SMW_CONSTRAINT_ERR_CHECK_MAIN`, main-data-only), or `"check/all"` (= `SMW_CONSTRAINT_ERR_CHECK_ALL`, all entities). The `SMW_CONSTRAINT_ERR_CHECK_*` constants resolve to these string values and continue to work.

CheckForRemnantEntities.description: Controls when remnant entity checks run: `"purge"` (on purge only), `true` (every update), or `false` (disabled).

CompactLinkSupport.description: When `true`, encodes and compresses Special:Browse / Special:Ask / Special:SearchByProperty links to reduce URL length.

ConfigFileDir.description: Deprecated since 7.0.0; will be removed in 8.0.0. Install-state metadata is now stored in the `smw_meta` database table. This setting is kept only so that the one-shot migration of any pre-existing `.smw.json` file can find its source location. Historical default: the extension root; sites that overrode it (for example to `$wgUploadDirectory`) must keep the override in place until `update.php` has run once and migrated the file to `.smw.json.migrated`.

CreateProtectionRight.description: User right required to create new properties; `false` disables creation protection.

DataTypePropertyExemptionList.description: DataTypes exempted from the automatic corresponding-property registration.

DVFeatures.description: DataValue feature flags. Array of any of: `provider-redirect`, `monolingual-langcode`, `number-value-usespaces`, `pattern-validation`, `wpv-display-title`, `provider-display-title`, `unique-constraint`, `time-calendar-model`, `preferred-label`, `provider-link-hint`, `wpv-pipetrick`. Legacy `SMW_DV_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

DefaultLoggerRole.description: Logging granularity role (`developer`, `user`, or `production`); controls which SMW events are written to the debug log.

DefaultNumRecurringEvents.description: Default number of recurring-event instances generated when no end date is set.

DefaultOutputFormatters.description: Default output formatter overrides keyed by type ID, type name, or property name.

DefaultStore.description: Default storage backend class; `SQLStore::class` evaluates to this fully-qualified string at compile time.

DeprecationNotices.description: Registry of deprecation notices shown in the Special:Admin "Deprecation notices" panel.

DetectOutdatedData.description: When `true`, verifies semantic data is up to date with the latest revision on every page load.

Dir.description: Alias for `smwgIP`; resolves to the extension root directory. Provided for readability in code that does not use `smwgIP` directly.

EditProtectionRight.description: User right required to edit pages protected via `Is edit protected`; `false` disables the feature.

ElasticsearchEndpoints.description: ElasticSearch node endpoint definitions (host/port/scheme objects or `host:port` strings).

ElasticsearchProfile.description: Path to a JSON profile that overrides `smwgElasticsearchConfig` values; `false` disables profile loading.

EnabledDeferredUpdate.description: When `true`, defers store updates via MediaWiki's `DeferredUpdates` mechanism.

EnabledEditPageHelp.description: When `true`, displays SMW help information on the edit page.

EnabledFulltextSearch.description: When `true`, stores text in a separate fulltext-indexed table for SQL fulltext operations.

EnabledQueryDependencyLinksStore.description: When `true`, stores query dependencies to enable parser-cache invalidation when queried entities change.

EnabledSpecialPage.description: Special pages on which SMW annotation and content processing is enabled.

EnableExportRDFLink.description: When `true`, adds a `Special:ExportRDF` `<link>` element to every page `<head>`.

EnableUpdateJobs.description: When `false`, disables MediaWiki job-queue updates triggered by semantic data changes.

EntityCollation.description: Collation strategy for entity sort values; must match `$wgCategoryCollation`; changes require running `updateEntityCollation.php`.

ExportBacklinks.description: When `true`, backlinks are included by default in OWL/RDF exports.

ExportBCAuxiliaryUse.description: BC: when `true`, retains the legacy `aux`-marker URIs in RDF/Turtle exports.

ExportBCNonCanonicalFormUse.description: BC: when `true`, uses localized rather than canonical identifiers in RDF/Query statements.

ExportResourcesAsIri.description: When `true`, resources are exported as IRIs (RFC 3987) instead of ASCII-encoded URIs.

ExperimentalFeatures.description: Experimental feature flags. Array of any of: `queryresult-prefetch`, `showparser-curtailment`. Legacy `SMW_QUERYRESULT_*` / `SMW_SHOWPARSER_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

ExtraneousLanguageFileDir.description: Directory containing SMW-specific i18n files for extraneous language data (unit labels, property aliases, etc.).

FactboxFeatures.description: Factbox feature flags. Array of any of: 'cache', 'purge-refresh', 'display-subobject', 'display-attachment'. Legacy `SMW_FACTBOX_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

FallbackSearchType.description: Search engine class to fall back to when SMWSearch cannot parse a query; `null` uses the database default.

FieldTypeFeatures.description: SQLStore field-type modifications. `false` (= `SMW_FIELDT_NONE`) disables all flags and skips field-type registration entirely; an array of `"char-nocase"` and/or `"char-long"` enables case-insensitive collation / extended field width respectively. Legacy `SMW_FIELDT_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

FixedProperties.description: Properties managed in their own fixed database table for sharding large value sets.

FulltextDeferredUpdate.description: When `true`, defers fulltext index updates to a background process decoupled from the storage update.

FulltextLanguageDetection.description: Language-detector configurations for fulltext indexing; empty disables language detection.

FulltextSearchIndexableDataTypes.description: DataTypes whose values are eligible for fulltext indexing. Array of any of: `blob`, `uri`, `wikipage`. Legacy `SMW_FT_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

FulltextSearchMinTokenSize.description: Minimum token length used to decide between MATCH and LIKE operators in fulltext conditions.

FulltextSearchPropertyExemptionList.description: Property keys excluded from fulltext indexing; LIKE/NLIKE is used for these instead.

IgnoreExtensionRegistrationCheck.description: When `true`, suppresses the check that verifies the extension was correctly registered via `wfLoadExtension`.

IgnoreQueryErrors.description: When `true`, queries execute even if errors were detected during parsing.

IgnoreUpgradeKeyCheck.description: When `true`, bypasses the `SetupCheck` and `MaintenanceCheck` gates that block execution when the schema is in an intermediate state.

ImportFileDirs.description: Directories from which SMW reads import-content definitions; users add their own vocabularies by adding entries.

ImportPerformers.description: Users reserved exclusively for the import task; they may lock content from alteration by others.

ImportReqVersion.description: Import-file version required for content to be imported during setup; set to `false` to disable import.

IP.description: Path to the SMW extension root directory as seen on the local filesystem. Used to resolve PHP file paths within the extension.

JobQueueWatchlist.description: Job types shown in the personal-bar job-queue watchlist; empty disables the feature.

MandatorySubpropertyParentTypeInheritanc.description: When `true`, enforces type inheritance between a parent property and its subproperties.

MaxNonExpNumber.description: Largest number displayed without scientific notation.

MaxNumRecurringEvents.description: Maximum number of recurring-event instances that can be defined regardless of end date.

MaxPropertyValues.description: Maximum number of property values displayed per property on a page's Property page.

Namespace.description: URI/IRI namespace for OWL/RDF export resources; auto-derived from the wiki URL when `null`.

PageSpecialProperties.description: Special properties automatically tracked and stored for pages (e.g. modification date).

PagingLimit.description: Number of results shown in the listings on pages in the Property and Concept namespaces as well as other services that require a limit.

PDefaultType.description: Internal type ID assumed for properties that have no explicit type declaration; defaults to `Type:Page`.

PlainList.description: When `true`, `format=list` produces plain lists without HTML markup, restoring pre-3.0 behaviour.

ParserFeatures.description: Parser feature flags. Array of any of: `strict`, `unstrip`, `inline-errors`, `hidden-categories`, `links-in-values`. Legacy `SMW_PARSER_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

PostEditUpdate.description: Regulates task specific settings for the post-edit process.

PropertyInvalidCharacterList.description: Characters considered invalid in property labels; annotations using them produce an error.

PropertyLowUsageThreshold.description: Usage count below which a property is highlighted as "hardly used" on Special:Properties.

PropertyReservedNameList.description: Names reserved as property names because they interfere with SMW or MediaWiki internals.

PropertyRetiredList.description: Property prefixes / IDs marked as retired and eligible for removal from the entity table.

PropertyZeroCountDisplay.description: When `true`, properties with zero usage are shown on Special:Properties.

QComparators.description: Pipe-delimited list of comparator operators supported in queries.

QConceptCacheLifetime.description: Concept cache lifetime in minutes; SMW recomputes an older cache if this threshold is exceeded.

QConceptCaching.description: Concept-cache use policy. Accepts `"none"`, `"hard"`, or `"all"`. Legacy `CONCEPT_CACHE_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QConceptMaxDepth.description: Maximum property-chain depth for a concept query.

QConceptMaxSize.description: Maximum number of conditions permitted in a concept query.

QConceptFeatures.description: Query feature flags applied to concept-page query parsing. Array of any of: `property`, `category`, `concept`, `namespace`, `conjunction`, `disjunction`. Legacy `SMW_*_QUERY` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QDefaultLimit.description: Default number of result rows returned by an inline query.

QDefaultLinking.description: Default linking behaviour for query results; one of `none`, `subject`, or `all`.

QDefaultNamespaces.description: Default namespaces searched by queries; `null` disables namespace restrictions for faster queries.

QEnabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable all query-related features and interfaces.

QEqualitySupport.description: Inverse / equality property handling: `"none"` disables, `"some"` enables redirects (default), `"full"` enables redirects and owl:sameAs. Legacy `SMW_EQ_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QExpensiveExecutionLimit.description: Maximum number of expensive `#ask` / `#show` calls per page; `false` means no limit.

QExpensiveThreshold.description: Time in seconds above which a `#ask` / `#show` call is classified as expensive.

QFeatures.description: Query feature flags. Array of any of: `property`, `category`, `concept`, `namespace`, `conjunction`, `disjunction`. Each enables the matching query type in inline queries; removing one disables it (e.g. drop `disjunction` to forbid OR clauses). Legacy `SMW_*_QUERY` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QFilterDuplicates.description: When `true`, filters duplicate query segments from the query build process (experimental).

QMaxDepth.description: Maximum property-chain depth of a query.

QMaxInlineLimit.description: Maximum number of result rows printed by a single inline query on a page.

QMaxLimit.description: Maximum number of results ever retrieved, even on special query pages.

QMaxSize.description: Maximum number of conditions permitted in a single query.

QPrintoutLimit.description: Maximum number of printout columns (`?`-statements) supported in a single query.

QSortFeatures.description: Sort feature flags. Array of any of: `sort` (allow sorting), `random` (allow random ordering), `unconditional` (allow unconditional sort). Legacy `SMW_QSORT*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QSubcategoryDepth.description: Maximum depth for sub-category inclusion steps within the category hierarchy.

QSubpropertyDepth.description: Maximum depth for sub-property inclusion steps within the property hierarchy.

QTemporaryTablesAutoCommitMode.description: When `true`, forces auto-commit for temporary tables to work around MySQL GTID restrictions.

QueryDependencyPropertyExemptionList.description: Property keys excluded from query-dependency detection to avoid spurious cache purges.

QueryProfiler.description: Query profiler. Accepts `false` to disable profiling entirely, `[]` for basic profiling, or an array of any of `parameters`, `duration` for granular detail fields. Note that `[]` enables basic profiling (it does NOT disable); use `false` to disable. Legacy `true` (alias for `[]`) and `SMW_QPRFL_*` integer constants are accepted with a deprecation notice in 7.x and will be removed in 8.0.

QueryResultCacheLifetime.description: Lifetime in seconds for embedded query result caches; default one week.

QueryResultCacheRefreshOnPurge.description: When `true`, embedded query result caches are invalidated when an `action=purge` event fires.

QueryResultNonEmbeddedCacheLifetime.description: Lifetime in seconds for non-embedded (Special:Ask, API) query result caches; `0` disables.

D: Button fixed to bottom right

ArticleGuidanceExperimentJuniorEditorsOn.description: When true, the red-link/entry-point experiment only admits junior editors: in addition to the createpage permission and not being blocked, the user's edit count must be below ArticleGuidanceJuniorEditorThreshold. Default false admits all eligible logged-in users regardless of edit count.

ArticleGuidanceWikidataConnectEnabled.description: When true, a published article is automatically connected to the Wikidata item the user selected, by adding a sitelink. Default false so non-production environments never write to Wikidata.

ArticleGuidanceWikidataUrls.description: Wikidata endpoint URLs. In 'view', $1 is the Wikidata item Id (Q id). Client and server share these; only the server SPARQL endpoint can be overridden separately, via ArticleGuidanceSparqlEndpoint.

ArticleGuidanceSparqlEndpoint.description: SPARQL endpoint URL for server-side Wikidata queries (WikidataInfoFetcher). In production this points at the internal proxy; the browser keeps using the public endpoint from ArticleGuidanceWikidataUrls.

ArticleGuidanceCxServerUrl.description: Base URL of the cxserver machine-translation endpoint used by the client to translate non-Latin topic-matching queries. The source language, target language, and MinT provider are appended as path segments (/{from}/{to}/MinT).

ArticleGuidanceCxTargetLanguage.description: Language code that non-Latin topic-matching queries are translated into before searching Wikidata.

AREUseInitialRatings.description: If true, the ratings tag has an init-rating parameter that wil set the initial rating to the codename supplied, not the default. Not recommended for production use, but can be used as a workaround to allow bots to use the extension.

ARENamespaces.description: Array of namespace numbers/constants that are allowed to have ratings on them.

ArticleToCategory2ConfigBlacklist.description: Set this flag to true to enable the category blacklist in "MediaWiki:Add Article to Category 2 excluded categories" page (you need to create this page first)

AutoModeratorEnableLogOnlyMode.description: Enable AutoModerator automatic revision checks that creates logs instead of reverting

AutoModeratorWikiId.description: language code of project used to target liftwing lang parameter

AutoModeratorLiftWingBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the LiftWing service. We set it by default to use the API Gateway endpoint which is publicly accessible and is modified by mediawiki deployments that run within the production WMF cluster and have access to the internal endpoint.

AutoModeratorLiftWingAddHostHeader.description: Whether to add the Host header to the LiftWing request. This is required for Lift Wing requests made using the internal endpoint within the WMF infrastructure.

AutoModeratorLiftWingRevertRiskHostHeade.description: Hostname to use with header for requests to RevertRisk endpoint.

AutoModeratorLiftWingMultiLingualRevertR.description: Hostname to use with header for requests to RevertRisk multilingual endpoint.

AutoModeratorFalsePositivePageTitle.description: The page title of the false positive reporting page.

AutoModeratorUseEditFlagMinor.description: Enables the minor edit flag for AutoModerator to use when making its edits.

AutoModeratorRevertTalkPageMessageEnable.description: Enable or disable sending talk page messages informing the user that an edit has been reverted.

AutoModeratorRevertTalkPageMessageRegist.description: Enable or disable sending talk page messages to named users only.

AutoModeratorEnableBotFlag.description: Enable whether AutoModerator uses the Bot flag when making its edits

AutoModeratorSkipUserRights.description: Edits made by accounts with one or more of these rights will not be checked by AutoModerator.

AutoModeratorCautionLevel.description: Controls the caution level that AutoModerator uses when scoring edits.

AutoModeratorEnableUserRevertsPerPage.description: Enables specifying how many times AutoModerator can revert the same user on a given page within 24 hours.

AutoModeratorUserRevertsPerPage.description: Specify how many times AutoModerator can revert the same user on a given page within 24 hours.

AutoModeratorMultiLingualRevertRisk.description: A boolean that indicates whether the wiki is multilingual capable.

AutoModeratorHelpPageLink.description: A link that appears in the talk page message that leads them to a community-selected help page.

AutoModeratorMultilingualEnableLogOnlyMo.description: Enable AutoModerator automatic revision checks that creates logs instead of reverting

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigFalsePosi.description: The page title of the false positive reporting page.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigUseEditFl.description: Enables the minor edit flag for AutoModerator to use when making its edits.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigRevertTal.description: Enable or disable sending talk page messages informing the user that an edit has been reverted.
Enable or disable sending talk page messages to named users only.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigEnableBot.description: Enable whether AutoModerator uses the Bot flag when making its edits

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigSkipUserR.description: Edits made by accounts with one or more of these rights will not be checked by AutoModerator.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigCautionLe.description: Controls the caution level that AutoModerator uses when scoring edits.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigEnableUse.description: Enables specifying how many times AutoModerator can revert the same user on a given page within 24 hours.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigUserRever.description: Specify how many times AutoModerator can revert the same user on a given page within 24 hours.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigHelpPageL.description: A link that appears in the talk page message that leads them to a community-selected help page.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigEnableMul.description: Enables use of the multilingual revert risk model.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigMultiling.description: The threshold the multilingual revert risk model will use to determine whether an edit will be reverted.

AutoModeratorMultilingualConfigEnableLan.description: Enables use of the language-agnostic revert risk model.

BabelUseCommunityConfiguration.description: Should CommunityConfiguration extension be used to provide configuration?

ArticlePreviewCapturePhantomJSEscapeShel.description: If you need to add command line variable before command set this to false

AuthorsNamespaceBlacklist.description: Defaults to NS_FILE, NS_FILE_TALK, NS_MEDIAWIKI, NS_MEDIAWIKI_TALK, NS_CATEGORY, NS_CATEGORY_TALK

ESRecentBoostFactor.description: Value must be between 0 and 1. If set to 1, very recent pages will almost double their score

ESMatchPercentBoostFactor.description: How much to boost the result based on the percent of its title taken up by the search term. Set to 0 to disable

ESMatchPercentTitleField.description: Field on which to base the match percent boosting. If empty, default title field of the source will be used

ESExcludeNamespaces.description: Namespaces to exclude from search. Add to `autocomplete` array to exclude from AC only, or to `search` array as well to exclude from both AC and fulltext

ESLimitPagesToContentNamespaces.description: Only return wiki pages from content namespaces. Does not affect other document types, like blog posts, processes or files

ESUseSharedUploads.description: If `$wgUseSharedUploads` is set to true, this setting will allow to search for files in the shared upload directory

ESSharedUploadsIndexPrefix.description: Prefix for the search index in the shared uploads wiki

ESAutoRecognizeSubpages.description: If true, search for subpages will automatically be recognized and filters adjusted

ESSubpageMasterFilterPatterns.description: List of regexes specifying pattern of page names on which to turn this feature on

ESSubpageMasterFilterUseRootOnly.description: Whether to use the whole name of the current page or just the root part

ESIndexPrefix.description: Which prefix to use on the index names. Will use `WikiMap::getCurrentWikiId()` if empty.

ESSecureResults.description: If true, results will be filtered to only show pages the user has access to

ESSecureResultsRigor.description: Can be `strict` or `quick`. In quick mode, only general namespace permission are checked, which in strict mode, permissions for each individual page are checked.

ESDefaultContext.description: Default context to be used when going from autocomplete to fulltext search
