GEHomepageSuggestedEditsEnabled.description: Global ON/OFF switch for the suggested edits feature on the homepage.

GEHomepageSuggestedEditsEnableTopics.description: Enable topic filters for suggested edits

GENewcomerTasksTaskTypeHandlers.description: Used for registering TaskTypeHandlers to the TaskTypeHandlerRegistry. An associative array with handler ID => handler specification, which is an ObjectFactory specification or a factory callable. Handlers IDs correspond to the 'type' parameters in the task config page.

GENewcomerTasksRemoteApiUrl.description: URL of a remote API (ending with 'api.php') to use for identifying suggested edits. This is meant for developer setups.

GENewcomerTasksRemoteArticleOrigin.description: Origin to append suggested article URLs to (e.g. 'https://en.wikipedia.org'). This is meant for developer setups.

GERestbaseUrl.description: URL of the RESTBase service (PCS Summary API - see https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Page_Content_Service#/page/summary) used for task cards. Autogenerated from the wiki URL when not set.

GEMediaInfoRepos.description: List of repo names which provide WikibaseMediaInfo data.

GEDeveloperSetup.description: Set to true in developer (non-production) settings. In practice this will relax assumptions about page existence, which might be needed to approximate production behavior when e.g. a remote API is used for searching for pages, or a link recommendation service trained on a production wiki is used on a testing wiki.

GENewcomerTasksLinkRecommendationsEnable.description: Global ON/OFF switch for link recommendations.

GELinkRecommendationsFrontendEnabled.description: Global ON/OFF switch for the link recommendations feature. Depending on the state, either the 'links' or the 'link-recommendation' task type is hidden. Can be overridden by SuggestedEdits::LINK_RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED_PREF.

GELinkRecommendationsRefreshByIteratingT.description: Whether to refresh link recommendations by iterating through all titles. Temporary config while rolling out this new system, see T386250

GETopicsMatchModeEnabled.description: Global ON/OFF switch for the topics match mode UI feature.

GENewcomerTasksImageRecommendationsEnabl.description: Global ON/OFF switch for image recommendations.

GENewcomerTasksSectionImageRecommendatio.description: Global ON/OFF switch for section-level image recommendations.

GEImageRecommendationServiceUrl.description: Root URL of the image recommendation service (no trailing slash).

GEImageRecommendationServiceHttpProxy.description: HTTP proxy for the service specified via GEImageRecommendationServiceUrl.

GEImageRecommendationServiceUseTitles.description: Use titles instead of page IDs when calling the service. Less ideal but allows setting up test environments to use the production service.

GEImageRecommendationApiHandler.description: Corresponding API handler to use for the (top-level and section-level) image recommendations; can be 'production' (ProductionImageRecommendationApiHandler), 'mvp' (MvpImageRecommendationApiHandler) or 'actionapi' (ActionApiImageRecommendationApiHandler). See these classes for more information.

GEImageRecommendationServiceWikiIdMasque.description: The wiki ID to use in requests to the image recommendation service. Used for developer setups.

GEImageRecommendationServiceAccessToken.description: Personal access token from the wiki GEImageRecommendationServiceUrl points to. For developer setups using the 'actionapi' handler only.

GELinkRecommendationServiceUrl.description: Root URL of the link recommendation service. When using the 'actionapi' handler, this should point to api.php.

GELinkRecommendationServiceAccessToken.description: Personal access token from api.wikimedia.org to use when accessing the external production service. For developer setups only.

GELinkRecommendationServiceTimeout.description: Request timeout when contacting the link recommendation service.

GELinkRecommendationsUseEventGate.description: Whether to use EventGate for notifying about link recommendation creation. When set to false, uses CirrusSearch diretcly.

GELinkRecommendationServiceWikiIdMasquer.description: The wiki ID to use in requests to the link recommendation service. Used for developer setups.

GELevelingUpManagerInvitationThresholds.description: Article namespace edit count thresholds at which the user should be invited to try suggested edits (assuming they haven't before).

GECampaigns.description:
A map of campaign ID to campaign configuration. Campaign configuration currently includes these fields:
* pattern: a regexp matched against the "campaign" request parameter during signup to determine whether the user should be included in some campaign
* topics: an array of topic IDs (which are defined in GECampaignTopics) to include on the top of the topic selector as custom topics

Examples can be found at https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:GrowthExperiments/Technical_documentation/Special:EditGrowthConfig.

GECampaignTopics.description: Mapping of topic IDs to its search expression, used to show campaign-specific topics in the suggested edits module. Examples can be found at https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:GrowthExperiments/Technical_documentation/Special:EditGrowthConfig.

WelcomeSurveyExperimentalGroups.description: List of experimental groups. A group is defined with a range to randomly match users and the list of questions they will see on the survey.

GELinkRecommendationMinimumTasksPerTopic.description: Minimum number of link recommendation tasks to maintain per ORES topic.

GEUserImpactMaxEdits.description: Maximum number of edits to process for Impact Module statistics

GEUserImpactMaxThanks.description: Maximum number of thanks to process for Impact Module statistics

GEReviseToneSuggestedEditEnabled.description: Enable the Revise Tone feature so newcomers can spot non-neutral wording and receive in-context guidance to help users rewrite a sentence in a more encyclopedic tone.

GEReviseToneParagraphScoreThreshold.description: Threshold score above which a Tone issue is considered for the ReviseTone task

GEReviseToneOverrideSearchTerm.description: Overrides generating the search terms for the ReviseTone task. Should only be set to something other than an empty string in beta or dev. Recommended value on beta: 'hastemplate:peacock_inline'. See ReviseToneTaskTypeHandler::getSearchTerm

GEReviseToneServiceUrl.description: Root URL of the internal Revise Tone service (no trailing slash).

GEReviseToneRecommendationProvider.description: Corresponding Recommendation Provider to use for the Revise Tone recommendations; can be 'production' (ApiReviseToneRecommendationProvider), or 'subpage' (SubpageReviseToneRecommendationProvider).

HashtagsMakeTagsSystemManaged.description: Make the change tags corresponding to Hashtags be system managed. When true, users are unable to add or remove hashtag style tags via Special:EditTags or manage them with Special:Tags. Users can still remove the tags by revision deleting the edit summary.

HashtagsRequireActiveTag.description: When true, hashtags must first be created and active in Special:Tags before being considered a valid tag. Activating a tag is not retroactive

IPInfoGeoLite2Prefix.description: Path to the directory containing either GeoLite2- or GeoIP2- depending on database files downloaded; should contain prefix (GeoLite2-/GeoIP2-)

IPInfoGeoIP2EnterprisePath.description: Path to the directory containing the GeoIP2 Enterprise and Anonymous IP database file; should contain the trailing slash

IPInfoMaxDistinctIPResults.description: The maximum number of distinct IP addresses to show on Special:IPInfo

IPReputationDataProvider.description: Name of the provider to use for retrieving IP reputation data. Valid values: "nodejs_ipoid". If not set, the provider will always return null for IP reputation lookups.

IPReputationIPoidCheckAtAccountCreation.description: Feature flag to enable/disable auditing account creation based on IP reputation data from IPoid service https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Service/IPoid.

IPReputationIPoidRequestTimeoutSeconds.description: Number of seconds to use for timeout option to HTTP request factory when calling IPoid

IPReputationIPoidConnectTimeoutSeconds.description: Number of seconds to use for connectTimeout option to HTTP request factory when calling IPoid

IPReputationDeveloperMode.description: If developer mode is enabled. This should be set to false in production. Developer mode can affect whether e.g. SSL certification validation is enabled in HTTP requests

ImageSuggestionsSuggestionsApi.description: API endpoint for image suggestions (required); 2 params will be sprintf'ed into the url: 1/ the wiki id & 2/ the page id. Example: 'http://<host>:<port>/public/image_suggestions/suggestions/%1$s/%2$d'. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Platform_Engineering_Team/Data_Value_Stream/Data_Gateway#Suggestions

ImageSuggestionsInstanceOfApi.description: API endpoint for instance of cache (required); 2 params will be sprintf'ed into the url: 1/ the wiki id & 2/ the page id. Example: 'http://<host>:<port>/private/image_suggestions/instanceof_cache/%1$s/%2$d'. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Platform_Engineering_Team/Data_Value_Stream/Data_Gateway#Instanceof_(cache)

ImpactModuleThrowOnFailures.description: Throw any errors that happen during metric computation (useful for development)

InboxEnabled.description: Global ON/OFF switch for the Inbox features.

InboxSkipRegularEmail.description: Whether to skip sending email in the regular way, and only use Inbox

InboxHideProductionWarningBanner.description: Safeguard configuration to ensure installation of the extension is deliberate and NOT on a production site.

InlineCategorizerNamespaces.description: Optionally enable InlineCategorizer only on a set of namespaces. Default is all. Example: $wgInlineCategorizerNamespaces = [ NS_MAIN, NS_PROJECT ];

InlineCommentsAutoDeleteComments.description: Automatically delete comments if the text they are commenting on was removed or can no longer be found

InlineCommentsNamespaces.description: Namespaces for which InlineComments should be enabled

InterwikiSortingSort.description: The default sort order to use. 'code' is build in and orders alphabetically by interwiki code.

InterwikiSortingSortPrepend.description: Codes that should appear at the start of the list of interwiki links.

InterwikiSortingInterwikiSortOrders.description: Definition of sort orders. Each sort order key should be the sort order name, for example 'alphabetical'. Each key should have a value of an array of interwiki codes in the order to be sorted.

JsonConfigTransformsEnabled.description: Enable use of Lua transforms on Data: page loaders through JCContentLoader and action=jsontransform. Requires Scribunto and $wgJsonConfigEnableLuaSupport to function.

JsonConfigUseCodeEditor.description: Use CodeEditor for editing JsonConfig pages.

JsonConfigUseCodeMirror.description: Use CodeMirror for editing JsonConfig pages.

KartographerStaticMapframe.description: Disables the module that turns <mapframe> tags into interactive mini-maps that can be panned and zoomed without leaving the page. Static maps are recommended on high-traffic wikis where your KartographerMapServer couldn't keep up. Clicking <maplink> and <mapframe> tags to open a fullscreen interactive map is always possible.

KartographerWikivoyageMode.description: Enables the group feature where different <maplink> and <mapframe> tags can access each others data via group="…" and show="…" attributes. See [[mw:Help:Extension:Kartographer#Groups]]. Disabled by default. Meant to be enabled on Wikivoyage.

KartographerDfltStyle.description: Default map style to be used. Must be one of the values from KartographerStyles.

KartographerStyles.description: Available map styles users can request from your KartographerMapServer via mapstyle="…".

KartographerSrcsetScales.description: Set of allowed high-DPI pixelratios supported by your KartographerMapServer, to be used in and KartographerMapServer URLs. Must be in incremental order. Doesn't need to start with 1, this happens automatically.

KartographerMapServer.description: Server providing the map tiles. This is the only setting that doesn't have a default. You must provide a value. Note that the Wikimedia tile server "https://maps.wikimedia.org" can't be used outside of the Wikimedia cluster.

KartographerStaticFullWidth.description: The actual width of static map images when a <mapframe> uses the special value width="full". Relevant on wikis in static mode or when JavaScript is disabled. It's recommended to use one of the $wgImageLimits widths for consistency.

KartographerUseMarkerStyle.description: Allows Kartographer to extract marker styles from the GeoJSON to style a <maplink> accordingly. Currently only the "marker-color" is considered.

KartographerUsePageLanguage.description: Use the language of the page to render the map labels, instead of the language of the territory of the map (lang=local).

KartographerFallbackZoom.description: Fallback zoom value when no zoom="…" is given. Must be an integer between 0 (map shows the entire earth) and 19 (as close as possible). Currently only works with dynamic maps.

KartographerSimpleStyleMarkers.description: Use an api to generate markers using the simplestyle-spec for features.

KartographerNearby.description: Number of nearby articles to load via the coordinates API. A number between 100 and 500 is recommended. Requires the GeoData and CirrusSearch extensions to be installed. Set to 0 to disable the feature.

KartographerMediaWikiInternalUrl.description: Development setting allowing kartotherian to call back to the mapdata API on either a different MediaWiki server or via a non-standard port. Passed as a URL, e.g. "http://dev.wiki.local.wmftest.net:8080". Defaults to $wgServerName if not set.

KartographerParsoidVersion.description: Version of the Parsoid integration code. This is added to the extension data to enable cache rejection if necessary.

LDAPAuthentication2AllowLocalLogin.description: Allow users without an LDAP-backed ID to log into the wiki.

LDAPAuthentication2UsernameNormalizer.description: Use this function for normalizing username for LDAP, for example 'strtolower'. Needed after migration from earlier Version.

AutoAuthUsernameNormalizer.description: Use this function for normalizing username for LDAP, for example 'strtolower'. Needed after migration from earlier Version.

SyncMechanismRegistry.description: Allows registration of custom group sync mechanisms

groupsync.@locally-managed: Only evaluated if 'allgroups' sync is used
groupsync.@mapping: Only evaluated if 'mappedgroups' sync is used

CacheType.description: The sort of cache to use for the connection information.

CacheTime.description: How long cached items should stick around in seconds

DomainConfigProvider.description: Specifies the mechanism for obtaining the domain configuration

DefaultDomain.description: Specifies which domain to choose for a user, if no mapping from the database is available

LanguageSelectorLanguages.description: Languages to offer in the language selector

LanguageSelectorShowCode.description: Determine if language codes are shown in the selector, in addition to names

LanguageSelectorShowAll.description: Show all languages defined, not only those with a language file

LanguageTagLanguages.description: Adjust that array to set what language tag's should be parsed. E.g. 'en', 'hu'

LastModifiedRange.description:
This variable controls the display range.
See documentation on https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:LastModified for more details.

LastModifiedNamespaces.description: The namespaces in which the last modified text will be displayed.

LegalLoginPolicies.description: The list of legal policies that will require acceptance during account creation and login. Only pages in NS_MEDIAWIKI namespaces allowed as correct values

LegalLoginQuestions.description: The questions that users will need to answer correctly before login.  Only pages in NS_MEDIAWIKI namespaces allowed as correct values

LegalLoginExpiration.description: Require acceptance of legal policies again after defined seconds

LegalLoginInterval.description: Require acceptance of legal policies again after defined number of logins

LegalLoginLogActions.description: Save LegalLogin actions like acceptance of the policies to Special:Log

EnableEditFormLinkSuggest.description: Whether to load LinkSuggest on edit pages

wgLinkSuggestMaxSuggestions.description: Maximum amount of suggestions to show

QuerySparqlInSpecialPage.description: Query by default in the editor SPARQL

SPARQLServiceByDefault.description: Without parameters (config or endpoint) the SPARQL queries are sent at this SPARQL service.

SPARQLParserTableByDefault.description: SPARQL parser can print a table with different formats: wiki or html. By default: html

ConfigSPARQLServices.description: Array of SPARQL services uses in this wiki. http://www.example.org is the configuration by default for all SPARQL service. If you need to change, be careful about other endpoints.

SPARQLServiceSaveDataOfWiki.description: If you specify the SPARQL service uses to save RDF data (in the RDF tag) on the pages of wiki, you are able to use the special page to clean/import all your RDF data and the wiki will save automatically all new RDF data.

GraphsToCheckWithShacl.description: If you save RDF data (in the RDF tag) on the pages of wiki with the parameter SPARQLServiceSaveDataOfWiki, you can add others graphs to check with Shacl via the same SPARQL endpoint.

CheckRDFPage.description: If you have install Rapper, you can choose to check the RDF when you save a page, with this option.

GoogleApiKey.description: Google API key, if you use Google charts. (https://developers.google.com/places/web-service/get-api-key)

OSMAccessToken.description: OpenStreetMap Access Token, if you use OpenStreetMap via the Leaflet charts. (https://www.mapbox.com/)

LqtPages.description: Allows activation of LiquidThreads on individual pages

LqtTalkPages.description: Allows switching LiquidThreads off for regular talk pages (intended for testing and transition)

LqtEnotif.description: Whether or not to activate LiquidThreads email notifications

ThreadActionsNoBump.description: Thread actions which do *not* cause threads to be "bumped" to the top. Numbers correspond to the change type constants defined in Threads.php.

LiquidThreadsMigrate.description: Switch this on if you've migrated from a version before around May 2009

LiquidThreadsDefaultPageLimit.description: The default number of threads per page

LiquidThreadsAllowUserControl.description: Whether or not to allow users to activate/deactivate LiquidThreads per-page

LiquidThreadsAllowUserControlNamespaces.description: Whether or not to allow users to activate/deactivate LiquidThreads in specific namespaces. null means either all or none, depending on the value of LiquidThreadsAllowUserControl.

LqtNamespaces.description: Namespaces in which to enable LQT

LiquidThreadsEnableNewMessages.description: Enable/Disable 'New messages' link and special page (Special:NewMessages)

LoginNotifyAttemptsKnownIP.description: The number of failed login attempts to permit from a known IP before a notification is triggered.

LoginNotifyExpiryKnownIP.description: The time-to-live of the count of failed login attempts from a known IP (from the time of the first failed attempt).

LoginNotifyAttemptsNewIP.description: The number of failed login attempts to permit from a new IP before a notification is triggered.

LoginNotifyExpiryNewIP.description: The time-to-live of the count of failed login attempts from a new IP (from the time of the first failed attempt).

LoginNotifyCheckKnownIPs.description: Whether to trigger a notification after failed logins from known IPs.

LoginNotifyEnableOnSuccess.description: Whether to trigger a notification after successful logins from unknown IPs.

LoginNotifySecretKey.description: Override this to use a different secret than $wgSecretKey

LoginNotifyCookieExpire.description: Expiry in seconds. Default is 180 days

LoginNotifyCookieDomain.description: Override to allow sharing login cookies between sites on different subdomains

LoginNotifyMaxCookieRecords.description: Maximum number of users (records) to track as having successfully logged in on a particular device.

LoginNotifyUseCentralId.description: Use central user IDs in the loginnotify_seen_net table. This should be set to true if the loginnotify_seen_net is in a shared database. CentralAuth should be installed and all users should be attached to it.

LoginNotifySeenExpiry.description: The expiry time of data in the loginnotify_seen_net table, in seconds. This should be a multiple of LoginNotifyBucketSize. Default is 180 days.

LoginNotifySeenBucketSize.description: The size of a time bucket used when storing data in the loginnotify_seen_net table, in seconds. If this is changed, the data in the loginnotify_seen_net will become invalid and the table should be truncated. Setting this to a small number will require additional storage space. Setting this to a large number will cause the data expiry time to be less accurate. Default: 15 days.

LoginNotifyDenyUnknownIPs.description: Whether to deny login from unknown IPs.

MachineTranslationCaching.description: Boolean. Whether to enable caching for translation subpages.

MachineTranslationCachingTime.description: Integer. The time in seconds to cache translations for.

MachineTranslationDisplayLanguageName.description: Boolean. Whether to display the language name in parentheses next to the page title on translation subpages. You may want to disable this if translate title is enabled.

MachineTranslationRobotPolicy.description: String. The robot policy to use for translation subpages.

MachineTranslationServiceConfig.description: Array. Configure the machine translation service. type: <required, the name of the service, allowed values: DeepL, Google, LibreTranslate>; url: <optional, required if using DeepL or LibreTranslate, the base API URL for the machine translation service>; apikey: <optional, required if using DeepL or Google Translate, the API key for the machine translation service>

MachineTranslationTimeout.description: Integer. The time in seconds before connecting to the machine translation service will timeout.

MachineTranslationTranslateTitle.description: Boolean. Whether to also translate the page title. This will create an extra request to the machine translation service.

MachineTranslationUseJobQueue.description: Boolean. Whether to use the job queue for processing translations. This will not work if you do not have caching enabled and have a sensible expiry configured.

MathDisableTexFilter.description: To access this at run-time, use MathConfig::texCheckDisabled(). Do not use the non-normalized configuration directly.

MathEntitySelectorFallbackUrl.description: Fallback value for wbEntitySelector if wbRepo is not configured. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:CORS for cross wiki communication.

MathTexMaxLength.description: Maximum string-length of a TeX expression for the Wikibase property type math. See Wikibase documentation on string-limits for other limits https://doc.wikimedia.org/Wikibase/master/php/docs_topics_options.html#autotoc_md317.

MathTexVCService.description: Determine which TexVC variant is used, currently available: 'mathoid', 'restbase' and 'local' (default).

MathSvgRenderer.description: Determine which SVG rendering service is used. Currently available 'mathoid', 'restbase'.

MathInternalRestbaseURL.description: Optional override of $wgMathFullRestbaseURL for internal calls from MediaWiki PHP. Use this to bypass public reverse proxies, avoid firewall rate-limiting, or prevent unnecessary external network hops.

MathFullRestbaseURL.description: This is used for external URLs to RESTBase from browsers, such as when embedding Mathoid SVGs by URL in HTML markup.

MathHTTPProxy.description: The HTTP proxy used for contacting RESTBase.

MathValidModes.description: To access this at run-time, use MathConfig::getValidRenderingModes(). Do not use the non-normalized configuration directly.

MathWikibasePropertyIdHasPart.description: Original Wikidata property that described the elements of a mathematical formula with the data type item.

MathWikibasePropertyIdInDefiningFormula.description: New Wikidata property that describe the elements of a mathematical formula with the data type 'mathematical expression'. This potentially replaces 'has part' in the future.

MathWikibasePropertyIdDefiningFormula.description: The property that describes the mathematical formula representing an item in Wikidata.

MathWikibasePropertyIdQuantitySymbol.description: The Wikidata property that is used to present mathematical expressions in 'has part'. The data type is 'string'.

MathWikibasePropertyIdSymbolRepresents.description: The Wikidata property that is used to present mathematical expressions in 'in defining formula'. The data type is 'item'.

MathSearchMinimumEditableIds.description: Minimum editable entity IDs by entity prefix. Use 0 to disable protection for a prefix. Only P (properties) and Q (items) are checked; other prefixes such as lexemes are ignored for forward compatibility. Protected low-numbered entities are intended to stay as cached upstream copies for resilience when the upstream Wikibase is unavailable.

MediaModeration.name: MediaModeration
author: Core Platform & Trust and Safety Teams
Trust and Safety Product Team

MediaModerationDeveloperMode.description: If the extension is in developer mode. Make sure this is false in production.

MediaModerationAddToScanTableOnUpload.description: If MediaModeration will add to the mediamoderation_scan table on upload. Useful to set to false when bulk adding files in local environment.

MediaModerationPhotoDNAMockServiceFiles.description: For CI and development setups. Two arrays of files names, FilesToIsMatchMap should contain a list of file names that the mock service says are a match to PhotoDNA's database; FilesToStatusCodeMap should contain a list of files mapped to PhotoDNA status codes. Files not in these maps will return STATUS_OK and IsMatch=false.

MediaModerationThumbnailWidth.description: Width, in pixels, that MediaModeration will prefer to use when transforming files to a thumbnail to send to PhotoDNA. Default is 250, which is listed in $wgThumbnailSteps on WMF production wikis. A different width may be chosen if the thumbnail width would result in a height that is less than $wgMediaModerationThumbnailMinimumSize['height'].

MediaModerationThumbnailMinimumSize.description: Minimum width and height that thumbnails need to be to used over the source image. Dictionary with a 'height' and 'width' key which should be integers.

MediaModerationThumborRequestTimeout.description: Timeout for HTTP requests to the Thumbor service, in seconds.

MediaModerationPhotoDNASubscriptionKey.description: Key for access to PhotoDNA service endpoint.

MediaModerationRecipientList.description: List of emails to be notified when suspicious content is detected.

MediaModerationFrom.description: Email from which notification are sent.

MediaModerationHttpProxy.description: HTTP proxy to use when calling PhotoDNA service.

MediaSearchExternalEntitySearchBaseUri.description: Url to API of Wikibase repository to use for autocomplete results, or leave empty to use local API. Set to `null` to disable autocomplete.

MediaSearchExternalSearchUri.description: Url to API of MediaWiki instance to use for search results, or leave empty to use local API.

MediaSearchAssessmentFilters.description: Optional Key/value pairs representing values for community assessment filter; values should be Wikidata statements in the format 'PXXX=Qxxx'.

MediaSearchAssessmentQuickviewLabels.description: Optional Key/value pairs representing possible Assessment values in file metadata and their corresponding labels

MediaSearchTabOrder.description: Optional array of values defining search type tab order. Array elements can have values: image, audio, video, page, other

MediaSpoilerEnableMark.description: Allow editors to mark sensitive media

ChatKicks.description: Enable the 'kicking' of other users by chatmods and sysops (and any and all other user groups with the 'modchat' user right)?

ChatRichMessages.description: Parse chat messages through the WikiText parser?

ChatSidebarPortlet.description: Show the online users module in the sidebar?

ChatOnlineTimeout.description: The length of time it takes for a user to be considered offline. Smaller values give faster response times for users to be considered offline, but increase the chance of users being reported offline when they aren't (there may just be a temporary blip in their connection to the server). Set in 100ths of a second. The default value of 6000 translates to 1 minute.

ChatFloodMessages.description: Stops users sending more than X messages per Y seconds. Defaults to 3 messages per 5 seconds.

ChatFloodSeconds.description: Stops users sending more than X messages per Y seconds. Defaults to 3 messages per 5 seconds.

ChatLinkUsernames.description: Link users' user names to their user pages in the main chat window?

ChatMeCommand.description: Enable "/me <text>" command that prints a status-type message?

ChatUseStyleAttribute.description: Allow the use of the style attribute on HTML elements?

ChatMaxMessageLength.description: Maximum individual chat message length in characters.

MessageCommonsDatabase.description: Database name of the MessageCommons database.

MessageCommonsLang.description: ISO-639 language code of the MessageCommons wiki.

MessageCommonsIsCommons.description: Are we running on the MessageCommons wiki? Setting this to true causes the extension's main functionality to *not* work, which _is_ required on the MessageCommons wiki to be able to edit the messages properly!

SendNewArticleToFriends.description: If set to true and the BlogPage extension is installed, the user will be prompted to send the newly created blog page via email to their friends after they've created a page in the blog namespace defined by the BlogPage extension.

MFScriptPath.description: Reroute search queries to a different host. Only applies to Special:EditWatchlist.

MFDefaultEditor.description: Default editor when there is no user preference set (mobile-editor). One of 'source', 'visual', or 'preference' (inherit desktop editor preference).

MFFallbackEditor.description: When MFDefaultEditor is set to 'preference' and no desktop preference is set, use this editor. Set to 'source' or 'visual'.

MFEnableVEWikitextEditor.description: Enable VisualEditor's wikitext editor as a replacement for MobileFrontend's source editor.

MFRemovableClasses.description: Selectors for elements to be removed from the HTML in content namespaces (defined in wgContentNamespaces) to save bandwidth.

MFEditNoticesConflictingGadgetName.description: Internal name of the 'edit notices on mobile' gadget, which conflicts with showEditNotices in EditorOverlay. showEditNotices will not run when the user has this gadget enabled.

MediaViewerExtensions.description: File extension allowlist, based on https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MediaStatistics. Remove an entry to exclude all images with that extension.

MediaViewerThumbnailBucketSizes.description: Array of preselected widths used to generate thumbnail URLs to avoid arbitrary size requests (see also wgUploadThumbnailRenderMap).

MediaViewerDownloadSizes.description: Array of preselected widths used to generate download URLs, widths need to be in $wgThumbnailSteps if used.

MediaViewerEnableByDefault.description: If true, Media Viewer will be turned on by default.

MediaViewerEnableByDefaultForAnonymous.description: Overrides $wgMediaViewerEnableByDefault for anonymous users. If set to null, will fall back to value of $wgMediaViewerEnableByDefault

MediaViewerRecordVirtualViewBeaconURI.description: If set, records a virtual view via the provided beacon URI.

MediaViewerMobileCarousel.description: Enables the mobile image carousel sitewide for qualifying article pages in MobileFrontend (production rollout). Takes precedence over the opt-in beta feature (see MediaViewerBetaFeature): where this is on, the carousel is shown to everyone and the beta opt-in is suppressed.

MediaViewerMobileBeta.description: If true, the beta mobile viewer (mmv.ui.beta) replaces the MobileFrontend image viewer for all users on the mobile site, except logged-in users who have disabled MediaViewer in their preferences.

MediaViewerExcludedImageSelectors.description: CSS selectors for images that should be excluded. These selectors typically indicate template-generated images, placeholders, or images that don't make sense in a carousel or gallery context.

MediaViewerBetaFeature.description: Offers the mobile image carousel as an opt-in Beta feature preference, for previewing it ahead of a sitewide rollout. Only takes effect where MediaViewerMobileCarousel is off; the sitewide flag takes precedence and suppresses the opt-in.

NamespaceThreshold.description: This should probably be 3000 as recommended by MediaWiki. But for backwards compatibility we'll stick with this default

NamespaceBlacklist.description: There are some widespread extensions that create namespaces. E.g. SemanticMediaWiki, PageForms, Widgets, Scribunto, ...

NamespaceRelations.description: Define extra namespaces and how they relate to the basic set of namespaces.

NetworkSessionProviderUsers.description: List of assoc arrays containing 'username', 'ip_ranges' and 'token'  keys configuring the list of users

NetworkSessionProviderAllowedUserRights.description: List of strings to limit user rights to. This does not grant any rights the user doesn't already have. Defaults to null, meaning no limits

NetworkSessionProviderCanAlwaysAutocreat.description: When true the provider will bypass account creation authorization. Defaults to false, meaning standard anonymous user account creation limits apply.

RegisterTrack.description: Should we track information about referred users into the user_register_track DB table?

MWOAuthCentralWiki.description: Wiki ID of OAuth management wiki. MWOAuthSecureTokenTransfer.description: Require HTTPs for user transactions that might send out secret tokens

MWOauthDisabledApiModules.description: List of API module classes to disable when OAuth is used for the request

MWOAuthReadOnly.description: Prevent write activity to the database. When this is true, consumers cannot be added or updated, and new authorizations are prohibited. Authorization headers for existing authorizations will continue to work. Useful for migrating database tables

OAuthAutoApprove.description: Rules for automatically approving new consumers (instead of requiring manual review by an OAuth admin before they are usable). Takes a list of conditions; meeting any one of the conditions results in auto-approval. Conditions are an associative array of <rule name> => <rule value>; the condition is met if every one of its rules is satisfied. Supported rules are: 'grants', which takes a list of grant names, and is satisfied when all the grants requested for the consumer are within that list; 'protocols', which takes an array of protocol names like 'https', and is satisfied when the callback URL's protocol is within that list.

OAuthGroupsToNotify.description: User groups to notify about new consumers that need to be reviewed

MWOAuthSessionCacheType.description: The cache type used for most temporary data storage. An index into $wgObjectCaches. The default is $wgSessionCacheType.

MWOAuthNonceCacheType.description: The cache type used for OAuth 1.0 nonces. An index into $wgObjectCaches. The default is $wgMWOAuthSessionCacheType.

OAuthSecretKey.description: Random 32-bit string used to encrypt OAuth requests. Generate using "base64_encode(random_bytes(32))"

OAuth2EnabledGrantTypes.description: List of OAuth2 grants that client applications can use

OAuth2PrivateKey.description: Private key or a path to the private key used to sign OAuth2 JWT being transmitted. Key needs to be >= 2048 bits

OAuth2Passphrase.description: Passphrase used to decrypt OAuth2 private key. Leave empty if the key is not encrypted

OAuth2PublicKey.description: Public key or a path to the public key used to verify OAuth2 resource requests

OAuth2GrantExpirationInterval.description: Controls validity period for access tokens (stored in the cache configured in MWOAuthSessionCacheType). Does not apply to owner-only clients, whose access tokens are always non-expiring. Accepts ISO 8601 durations or can be set to "infinity" or false for non-expiring tokens. Defaults to one hour.

OAuth2RefreshTokenTTL.description: Controls validity period for refresh tokens (stored in the cache configured in MWOAuthSessionCacheType). Accepts ISO 8601 durations or can be set to "infinity" or false for non-expiring tokens. Defaults to one month.

OAuth2RefreshTokenGracePeriod.description: Grace period in seconds after using a refresh token. During the grace period the token can be used again (to account for the client not receiving the new refresh token e.g. because of network errors, and having to retry the request).

OAuthUseJwtCookie.description: Whether to emit a JWT cookie when responding to an OAuth request which has no short-lived JWT (ie. it is either an OAuth 1 request or uses an owner-only consumer).

OAuthAllowInsecurePlaintextSignature.description: Allows clients to use the PLAINTEXT signature method. Meant for debugging signature errors. Never enable this in production!

OAuthStaticApps.description: A list of apps which are managed via configuration rather than via the DB. Intended for first-party apps. See examples/configurationBasedClient.php for documentation of the format and further details.

OAuthAuthenticationUrl.description: Must be configured in LocalSettings.php! The OAuth special page on the wiki. Passing the title as a parameter is usually more reliable E.g., http://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:OAuth

OAuthAuthenticationConsumerKey.description: Must be configured! The key that was generated for you when you registered your consumer. RSA private key isn't currently supported.

OAuthAuthenticationConsumerSecret.description: Must be configured! The secret that was generated for you when you registered your consumer. RSA private key isn't currently supported.

OAuthAuthenticationCanonicalUrl.description: Optionally set the Canonical url that the server will return, if it's different from the OAuth endpoint. OAuth will use wgCannonicalServer when generating the identity JWT, and this code will compare the iss to this value, or $wgOAuthAuthenticationUrl if this isn't set.

OAuthAuthenticationAccountUsurpation.description: Allow usurpation of accounts. If accounts on the OAuth provider have the same name as an already created local account, this flag decides if the user is allowed to login, or if the login will fail with an error message.

OAuthAuthenticationUsernameWhitelist.description: Only allow creation/login of usernames that are on a whitelist. Setting this to false allows any username to register and login.

OAuthAuthenticationGroupWhitelist.description: Only allow creation/login of users who are in groups on the remote wiki. Setting this to false allows any username to register and login.

OAuthAuthenticationAllowLocalUsers.description: Allow local account creation. Set this to false if you only want to use remote accounts. Note: Once local accounts exist, this extension will not prevent them from logging in.

OAuthAuthenticationRemoteName.description: A simple text string, naming the remote wiki (used for text like, "Login on <wikiname>". If this is false, a generic "Remote OAuth Wiki" is used, which users may not understand.

OAuthAuthenticationMaxIdentityAge.description: Max age that a session can go without re-validating the user's identity.

OAuthAuthenticationValidateSSL.description: If $wgOAuthAuthenticationUrl uses https, do we validate the certificate? This should always be true in production, but sometimes useful to disable while testing.

OAuthAuthenticationCallbackUrl.description: Callback URL (should point to Special:OAuthLogin/finish). If it is empty, the callback is assumed to be non-dynamic (and thus read from the consumer record of the target wiki). Under normal circumstances this should not be changed.

ScribuntoDefaultEngine.description: The name of the default script engine

description: Configuration for each script engine. Parameters:
* profilerPeriod - The profiler sample period, or false to disable the profiler

* allowEnvFuncs - Set this to true to allow setfenv() and getfenv() in user code. Note that these functions have been removed in Lua 5.2. Scribunto does not yet support Lua 5.2, but we expect support will be implemented in the future, and there is no guarantee that a simulation of setfenv() and getfenv() will be provided

* maxLangCacheSize - The maximum number of languages about which data can be requested. The cost is about 1.5MB of memory usage per language on default installations (during recache), but if recaching is disabled with `$wgLocalisationCacheConf['manualRecache'] = false;` then memory usage is perhaps 10x smaller
* errorFile - A filename to act as the destination for stderr from the Lua binary. This may provide useful error information if Lua fails to run. Set this to null to discard stderr output
* luaPath - The location of the Lua binary, or null to use the bundled binary

* shareInvocationEnv - Set this to false to give each module invocation its own separate global environment. If true, all module invocations share the same global environment, which improves performance but may cause conflicts

ScribuntoUseCodeEditor.description: Set to true to enable the CodeEditor extension integration

ScribuntoUseCodeMirror.description: Set to true to enable the CodeMirror extension integration

ScribuntoGatherFunctionStats.description: Set to true to enable gathering and reporting of performance data for slow function invocations.

ScribuntoSlowFunctionThreshold.description: If $wgScribuntoGatherFunctionStats is true, this variable specifies the percentile threshold for slow function invocations. Should be a value between 0 and 1 (exclusive).

ScribuntoLuaExtraTitleAttributes.description: Extra attributes added to Lua mw.title objects. Keys are the name of the attributes, and values are the ObjectFactory specification for resolving the attribute.

QuickViewMediaRepositoryApiBaseUri.description: Url to API of Commons repository used to fetch images for the selected page. If not set, the 'related images' section will not appear.

QuickViewDataRepositoryApiBaseUri.description: Url to API of Wikidata repository used to links for the selected page. If not set, the 'interwiki links' section will not appear.

QuickViewSearchFilterForQID.description: The search parameter used to link the current page with a QID to ensure that the search result are relevant to your search.

SecurePollKeepPrivateInfoDays.description: Maximum number of days after a poll ends to store and show private information about voters. After this number of days, 1) private info is hidden from the user interface, and 2) the private info gets deleted when running the PurgePrivateVoteData maintenance script. Set to 0 to hide/delete the data as soon as the poll ends.

SecurePollCreateWikiGroupDir.description: Directory containing files defining groups of wikis that can participate in an election. File names are defined in SecurePollCreateWikiGroups.

SecurePollExcludedWikis.description: List of wikis to be excluded from SecurePoll processes

SecurePollCreateWikiGroups.description: Array of $fileName => $messageKey for defining groups of wikis that can participate in an election, and the groups' labels in the Create form. Files should be stored in SecurePollCreateWikiGroupDir with the suffix .dblist, and contain a list of participating wikis. The suffix should be omitted from the file names given here.

SecurePollUseNamespace.description: Make the SecurePoll namespace available, and record election details to pages in this namespace as JSON. This namespace is a read-only record of changes to the poll, changes to the poll's messages in each language, and changes to the voter eligibility lists. It writes pages such as SecurePoll:1, SecurePoll:1/msg/en, and SecurePoll:1/list/include-list. A "reason" box is added to the various Special:SecurePoll edit pages, and whatever is typed there ends up as the edit summary for that revision. You can click on the history tab to see who has made what changes, when, and what their reason was. Must not be used together with SecurePollUseMediaWikiNamespace.

SecurePollUseMediaWikiNamespace.description: Similar to SecurePollUseNamespace, but records the election details to subpages of 'MediaWiki:SecurePoll', instead of creating a dedicated namespace. Must not be used together with SecurePollUseNamespace.

SecurePollUseLogging.description: Whether to log admin actions to securepoll_log table.

SecurePollMostActiveWikisThreshold.description: Consider only wikis where the user has more than X% of their edits as most active wikis

SecurePollEditOtherWikis.description: In a wiki farm, allows SecurePoll to create redirect polls at other wikis under certain conditions. Adds an option to Special:SecurePoll/create that controls this. If you are using a central votewiki, this should be enabled on your votewiki, and disabled on other wikis.

SelectCategoryNamespaces.description: List of namespaces in which this extension should be active.

SelectCategoryRoot.description: Root category to use for which namespace, otherwise self detection (expensive)

SemanticACLWhitelistIPs.description: IPs listed in this array are granted full access.

SemanticACLEnablePrivateLinks.description: If protected pages can be viewed by anyone using a private link with a key.

SemanticACLEnableCascadingACL.description: Parent pages can override the permissions of subpages.

ShowRealUsernamesInline.description: Whether to replace the wiki name with the real name. By default, the user's real name is appended to the wiki name in Special:ListUsers.

ShowRealUsernamesFields.description: List of extra fields to get from the database. These fields are obtained from the table user and substituted for $1, $2 etc. in messages.

SimpleChangesOnlyLatest.description: Show only the changes which are each page's most recent revisions. Avoids duplicate page titles.

SimpleChangesShowUser.description: Show the user who made the change.

SimpleChangesMaxCacheTime.description: Maximum seconds to cache when transcluded. Use -1 for MediaWiki default (5 min in miser mode, 0 otherwise).

SiteMatrixFile.description: A file with the list of language codes used by the wikifarm (one per line).

SiteMatrixSites.description: Configuration for project families (projects which are multilingual but each language is a separate wiki), in a <family> => [ 'name' => <human-readable name>, 'host' => <domain name>, 'prefix' => <interwiki prefix> ] format.

SmiteSpamCheckers.description: List of enabled checkers and respective weights.

SmiteSpamIgnorePagesWithNoExternalLinks.description: Should SmiteSpam ignore all pages that don't have any external links outside of template calls?

SmiteSpamQueryPageSize.description: Number of pages to analyze in one AJAX request.

SmiteSpamDisplayPageSize.description: Number of pages to display in one paginated page.

SpecialPageCaptchaCookieTTL.description: The time to live (TTL) in seconds for the cookie set by the extension, which allows the user to bypass the CAPTCHA. The default is 1800 (seconds), i.e. 60 seconds * 30 minutes.

SpecialPageCaptchaWhitelist.description: A whitelist of special pages which will never show the CAPTCHA. StaffEditsMessagePrefix.description: Short, organization-specific prefix used to build i18n message keys etc.

StaffEditsTags.description: A list of tags (without the prefix defined by $wgStaffEditsMessagePrefix). The associated user right needed to apply the tag in question is always derived from the tag name itself, e.g. the tag "swstaffedit" has the associated user right "staffedit".

StaffPowersShoutWikiMessages.description: Whether to use ShoutWiki-specific i18n messages (true) or not (false)

SMTPAuthenticationMethod.description: Set to 'tls' to enable TLS authentication.

SMTPTlsPeerVerification.description: Set to 'true' to disable TLS peer verification.

TemplateDataEnableDiscovery.description: Enable the template discovery and recall functionality.

TemplateDataMaxFavorites.description: The maximum number of favorite templates that can be stored.

TemplateDataEnableCategoryBrowser.description: Enable the category browser for the template discovery widget.

TemplateDataCategoryBrowserItem.description: Wikibase entity ID with which to look up the category browser's root category.

TemplateSandboxEditNamespaces.description: Namespaces to show a page preview box for in edit mode

TemplateStylesDisable.description: When set to true, no styles are output. This flag is for development and will be removed.

TemplateStylesAllowedUrls.description:
PCRE regexes to match allowed URLs for various types of external references. Known types are:
; audio: Sound files
; image: Images
; svg: SVGs for the Filter and Masking modules
; font: External fonts
; namespace: @namespace declarations
; css: @import declarations
If you want to allow an entire domain, be sure to include a trailing '/', e.g. "<^https://allowed\.example\.org/>" rather than "<^https://allowed\.example\.org>", so people can't bypass your filter by creating a subdomain like "https://allowed.example.org.evil.com". If the regex has a capture group named 'filename', then TemplateStyles will register that file as being in use by the page.

TemplateStylesNamespaces.description: Namespaces to default the content model to CSS on .css subpages.

TemplateStylesDisallowedProperties.description: Disallowed style properties that would otherwise be allowed. See also the TemplateStylesPropertySanitizer hook, which allows for finer-grained control.

TemplateStylesDisallowedAtRules.description: Disallowed at-rules that would otherwise be allowed. Include the '@' in the name. See also the TemplateStylesStylesheetSanitizer hook, which allows for finer-grained control.

TemplateStylesUseCodeEditor.description: Use CodeEditor when editing TemplateStyles CSS pages.

TemplateStylesUseCodeMirror.description: Use CodeMirror when editing TemplateStyles CSS pages.

TemplateStylesAutoParseContent.description: Set this false if you want to manage an entry for 'sanitized-css' in $wgTextModelsToParse manually. If true, an entry will be added to $wgTextModelsToParse automatically if CONTENT_MODEL_CSS is in the array.

TemplateStylesMaxStylesheetSize.description: The maximum size of a stylesheet, in bytes. Set null if you don't want to impose a limit.

TemplateStylesDefaultNamespace.description: The default namespace for the src attribute of the <templatestyles> tag. The value 10 corresponds to NS_TEMPLATE.

TestKitchenExperimentStreamNames.description: The names of the event streams for experiments configured in Test Kitchen.

TestKitchenAuthPreserveQueryParamsExperi.description: List of experiment names to use in the AuthPreseveQueryParams hook. For each experiment listed here, AuthPreserveQueryParams will add its assigned group to a query param in the form ?mpo=<experiment1-name:group>;<experiment2-name:group>

TwlUserPrimaryUrl.description: URL for the notification's primary link

TwlUserSecondaryUrl.description: URL for the notification's secondary link

TwlSendNotifications.description: Whether to send Wikipedia Library notifications. If set to false, no notifications will be sent.

TwlRegistrationDays.description: Minimum account age (in days) for a user to be eligible for the Wikipedia Library

TwlEditCount.description: Minimum (global) edit count for a user to be eligible for the Wikipedia Library

WaitTimeForTranscodeReset.description: How long you have to wait between transcode resets for non-error transcodes

MinimumVideoPlayerSize.description: The minimum size for an embed video player (smaller than this size, it uses a pop-up player)

MediaVideoTypes.description: Set the supported ogg codecs for video

MediaAudioTypes.description: Set the supported ogg codecs for audio

EnableTranscode.description: If transcoding is enabled for this wiki (if disabled, no transcode jobs are added and no transcode status is displayed). Note if remote embedding an asset we will still check if the remote repo has transcoding enabled and associated flavors for that media embed.

TranscodeBackgroundTimeLimit.description: The total amount of time a transcoding shell command can take

TranscodeBackgroundMemoryLimit.description: Maximum amount of virtual memory available to transcoding processes in KiB. 2GiB. ffmpeg mmap resources, so virtual memory needs to be high enough

TranscodeBackgroundSizeLimit.description: Maximum file size transcoding processes can create, in KiB. 3GiB.

TranscodeSoftSizeLimit.description: Maximum estimated file size for transcodes without admin approval, in KiB. Larger files must be manually re-enqueued by an admin via web or CLI interfaces. 2GiB.

FFmpegThreads.description: Number of threads to use in ffmpeg for transcoding

FFmpegVP9RowMT.description:
Whether to enable macroblock row multithreading for VP9 (-row-mt 1)

This allows increasing $wgFFmpegThreads to a larger number for VP9  transcodes; without it encoding will be limited to 4 threads for HD, or less for low resolution.

This requires libvpx 1.7 and a matching build of ffmpeg 3.3 or higher or it will fail with an unrecognized option error.

FFmpegLocation.description: Location of the ffmpeg binary (used to encode WebM and for thumbnails)

TimedTextNS.description: The NS for TimedText (registered on MediaWiki.org) https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension_namespace_registration Note that Wikimedia Commons pre-dates TimedMediaHandler, and sets this to 102.

TimedTextForeignNamespaces.description: Set TimedText namespace for ForeignDBViaLBRepo on a per wikiID basis like `$wgTimedTextForeignNamespaces = [ 'commonswiki' => 102 ];`.

EnabledTranscodeSet.description:
Enabled video transcodes.

See TranscodePresets.php for exact definitions. Broadly speaking: 'webm' refers to V8/Vorbis WebM, and 'v9.webm' refers to VP9/Opus WebM.

- If set to empty array, no derivatives will be created
- These transcodes are in addition to the source file.
- Transcodes with higher width than the source are skipped.
- Regardless of source size at least one WebM and Ogg source will be created from the $wgEnabledTranscodeSet.
- Transcode jobs are added to the MediaWiki JobQueue the first time the video is displayed.
- Transcode keys should be ordered from min to max.

EnabledAudioTranscodeSet.description:
Default enabled audio transcodes

 If set to empty array, no derivatives will be created
- These transcodes are *in addition to* the source file.
- Derivative should be listed min to max

llowed values:
* ogg – Ogg Vorbis
* opus – Note that Opus support must be available in ffmpeg
* mp3 – Note that fmpeg needs libmp3lame support
* m4a – Note that ffmpeg needs libvo_aacenc support

TmhEnableMp4Uploads.description: If MP4 source assets can be ingested

TmhFileExtensions.description: List of extensions handled by Timed Media Handler since its referenced in a few places. You should not modify this variable.

TmhPriorityResolutionThreshold.description: Transcode resolutions higher than this will run in the low-priority queue. This'll give us SD transcodes as fast as possible, then do HD later.

TmhPriorityLengthThreshold.description: Transcodes of files longer than this (seconds) will run in the low-priority queue; defaults to 15 minutes. This'll mean long videos won't flood the high-priority queue.

TmhFluidsynthLocation.description: Path of a Fluidsynth executable for MIDI conversion to audio formats

TmhSoundfontLocation.description: Path of a soundfont to use for MIDI-converted audio

TranslateEnableTranslateTaggerAPIIntegra.description: API URL path (string) to enable integration with the Translate Tagger API, or null to disable it.

TranslateRecentChangesLanguageFilter.description: Add language filter to the Special:RecentChanges

PageTranslationAllowedContentModels.description: Associative array of content model IDs where page translation should be possible. Set to true to allow.

PageTranslationLanguageList.description:

 * tag-only: Only display languages with the <languages /> tag.
 * sidebar-only: Display languages as interlanguage links only and ignore the tag even if present on the page.
 * sidebar-fallback: Display languages as interlanguage links if no tag is on the page.
 * sidebar-always: Display languages as interlanguage links and also in tag if it is present on the page.
@since 2018.07

TranslateDocumentationLanguageCode.description: Language code for message documentation. Suggested values are qqq or info. If set to false (default), message documentation feature is disabled.

TranslateEnableLuaIntegration.description: [Experimental] Enable integration with Lua modules using Scribunto extension.

TranslateEnableMessageGroupSubscription.description: Enable translators to watch message groups and receive notifications when messages in the group are added, removed or updated.

TranslateUserManagerName.description: Name of the system user that will be used to create the sandbox users in the system.

TranslateFuzzyBotName.description: Name of the bot which will invalidate translations and do maintenance for page translation feature. Also used for importing messages from external sources.

TranslateLanguageFallbacks.description:
Default values for list of languages to show translators as an aid when translating. Each user can override this setting in their preferences.

Example: LanguageFallbacks['fi'] = 'sv' or LanguageFallbacks['sv'] = [ 'da', 'no', 'nn' ].

TranslateSupportUrl.description: Experimental support since 2011-03-11 for an 'Ask' help button. Might change into a hook later on. This is an array with keys page, url and params: page is a title of a local wiki page; url is an URL to use as is (e.g. an issue tracker submission form) which will override the page if set; params is an array of key-value pairs of request params -- each param value can contain the variable %MESSAGE% which will be replaced with the full page name.

TranslateSupportUrlNamespace.description: Like $wgTranslateSupportUrl, but for a specific namespace. Each $wgTranslateSupportUrl-like array needs to be the value assigned to the numerical ID of a namespace of the wiki. Since 2015-09.

TranslatePageTranslationBannerNamespaces.description: List of namespace numbers for which the call to action banner to mark the page for translation will be displayed to editors who have recently updated the page. Since 2024.05

TranslatePermissionUrl.description: When unprivileged users open a translation editor, they will see a message stating that a special permission is needed for translating messages. If this variable is defined, there is a button which will take the user to that page to ask for permission. The target needs to be reiterated with the second variable to have the same result with sandbox enabled where users can't enter the sandbox.

EnablePageTranslation.description:
Enable page translation feature.

Page translation feature allows structured translation of wiki pages with simple markup and automatic tracking of changes. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Extension:Translate/Page_translation_administration

TranslateEnableEventLogging.description: Enable use of analytics on Special:Translate

TranslatePageTranslationULS.description:
If set to true, when a user selects an interface language via ULS (Universal Language Selector), if the current page is a translatable page or a translation page then the user is also redirected to the corresponding translation page in the selected language.

 The language of the translation pages visited afterwards will still depend on the links followed (it will be the interface language only if the links use the Special:MyLanguage syntax).

Since 2013-03-10.

TranslateKeepOutdatedTranslations.description:
If set to true, when a translated page has some units marked as outdated, the outdated translation will be shown. If set to false, the original updated unit in the original language will be shown.

Changing this setting requires the following script to be run to take effect on existing changes: scripts/refresh-translatable-pages.php

 Since 2016.12.

TranslateMessagePrefixStatsLimit.description: Represents the number of messages that can be queried via Special:MessageGroupStats when fetching message prefixes.

TranslateValidationExclusionFile.description: File containing validations that are to be skipped. See https://gerrit.wikimedia.org/g/translatewiki/+/master/groups/validation-exclusion-list.php for example.

TranslateAuthorExclusionList.description:
Two-dimensional array of rules that exclude certain authors from appearing in the exports. This is useful for keeping bots and people doing maintenance work in translations not to appear besides real translators everywhere.

Rules are arrays, where first element is type: included or excluded. The inclusion list always overrules the exclusion list. Second element should be a valid pattern that can be given a preg_match(). It will be matched against string of format 'group-id;language;author name', without quotes.

As an example, this rule would ignore all authors whose name ends in a bot for all languages and all groups:
'TranslateAuthorExclusionList': [ [ 'black', '/^.*;.*;.*Bot$/Ui' ] ]

TranslateMessageNamespaces.description: List of namespace that contain messages. No talk namespaces. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Extension:Translate/Group_configuration

TranslateGroupRoot.description: Location in the filesystem to which paths are relative in custom groups.

TranslateGroupFiles.description: The newest and recommended way of adding custom groups is YAML files.

TranslateGroupAliases.description: Map from deprecated group IDs to their current ID. Example value: { 'core': 'mediawiki-core' }

TranslateCacheDirectory.description: Set location of cache files. Defaults to $wgCacheDirectory.

TranslateMessageIndex.description: Configures how the message index is stored. Possible values are 'cdb' and 'database'. The first backend needs $wgCacheDirectory to be functional.

TranslateUseSandbox.description: Whether to allow users to sign up via a sandbox. Sandboxed users cannot do much until approved and thus they can be get rid of easily. This only works with MediaWiki 1.27 and newer, and only if registration is configured to not use account creation providers which give REDIRECT or UI responses or require any other field than the default username/password/email.

TranslateSandboxPromotedGroup.description: To which group the translators are promoted. If left at false, they will just be removed from sandbox and become normal users.

TranslateSandboxLimit.description: Maximum number of translations a user can make in the sandbox.

TranslateSandboxCreationHourlyLimit.description: Maximum number of sandbox accounts that can be created globally (across all users/IPs) per hour. Set to 0 to disable.

TranslateUsePreSaveTransform.description: Pre-save transform for message pages. MediaWiki does this by default (including for pages in the MediaWiki-namespace). By setting this to false it allows users to put untransformed syntax such as '~~~~' into a page without having them be transformed upon save.

TranslateRcFilterDefault.description: Default action for the RecentChanges filter, which makes it possible to filter translations away or show them only. Possible values: 'noaction', 'only', 'filter', 'site'.

TranslateYamlLibrary.description:
Currently supported YAML drivers are phpyaml or spyc.

For phpyaml see https://secure.php.net/manual/en/book.yaml.php.

phpyaml is the fastest and based on libyaml so the output should be most compatible. spyc output format is least compatible. spyc needs to be installed using composer. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Composer

TranslateTranslationDefaultService.description:
Name of the default translation memory service. This service must accept updates.

If left as the default `true`, the extension will fallback to 'TTMServer'. If `$wgTranslateTranslationServices` is also unconfigured, built-in values will be used to configure the TtmServer.

If set to `false`, no translation memory will be used.

TranslateTranslationServices.description:
Define various web services that provide translation suggestions.

Translation memories are documented in our main documentation. See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Extension:Translate/Translation_memories

For Apertium, you should get an API key. See http://wiki.apertium.org/wiki/Apertium_web_service

The machine translation services are provided with the following information: server ip address; versions of MediaWiki and Translate extension; source text to translate; private API key if provided

TranslateStatsProviders.description: Add, disable or overwrite default stats type providers.

TranslateGroupSynchronizationCache.description: If true, enables the group synchronization cache that keeps track of FileBasedMessageGroups messages currently being processed via UpdateMessageJob

TranslatePageMoveLimit.description: If set, displays a warning and does not allow user to move translatable pages having more subpages than this value

TuleapEnableLocalLogin.description: If true, no Oauth auto-login will be executed

TweetANewTweet.description: 'New': Automatically tweet about new articles. Default is true. 'Edit': Automatically tweet about articles when edited. Default is true. 'LessMinutesOld': Minutes since last edit to wait before tweeting about a new edit. Default is 5. 'SkipMinor': Skip minor edits. Default is true.

TweetANewText.description: 'Minor': Indicate in tweet if edit is marked as minor. Only applies if $wgTweetANewTweet['SkipMinor'] = false. Default is false. 'MinorSpace': Include a space after minor edit indicator. Only applies if $wgTweetANewTweet['SkipMinor'] = false and'Minor'] = true. Default is true. 'NewRandom': Use a mix of random messages in body of tweets about new articles. Default is true. 'NewRandomMax': Maximum number of random messages to use. Set any additional (beyond 3) using [[MediaWiki:Tweetanew-new4]], [[MediaWiki:Tweetanew-new5]], etc. Default is 3. 'NewAuthor': Display the author of the new article. Default is false. 'NewSummary': Display content entered into new article's summary box. Default is false. 'EditRandom': Use a mix of random messages in body of tweets about article edits. Default is true. 'EditRandomMax': Maximum number of random messages to use. Set any additional (beyond 3) using [[MediaWiki:Tweetanew-edit4]], [[MediaWiki:Tweetanew-edit5]], etc. Default is 3. 'EditAuthor': Display the author of the edit. Default is false. 'EditSummary': Display content entered into edit's summary box. Default is false. 'RealName': Determine if user's real name will be displayed instead of their username. Default is false.

TweetANewEditpage.description: 'Enable': Determine if checkbox to tweet from edit page if $wgTweetANewTweet['New'] = false or $wgTweetANewTweet['Edit'] = false. Default is false. 'Checked': Determine if checkbox to tweet from edit page is automatically checked.

TweetANewTwitter.description: 'ConsumerKey': Consumer key provided at https://dev.twitter.com/apps - be sure to have write and read permissions. 'ConsumerSecret': Consumer secret provided at https://dev.twitter.com/apps - be sure to have write and read permissions. 'AccessToken': Access token provided by the OAuth tool at https://dev.twitter.com/apps - be sure to have write and read permissions. 'AccessTokenSecret': Access token secret provided by the OAuth tool at https://dev.twitter.com/apps. Be sure to have write and read permissions.

TweetANewBitly.description: 'Enable': Display URL as bitly link - allowing you to track usage via your bitly account. Default is false. 'Login': If bitly link display is enabled, enter your bitly user account - signup at: http://bitly.com/a/sign_up. 'API': If bitly link display is enabled, enter your bitly API key - find your API key at: http://bitly.com/a/your_api_key

TweetANewGoogl.description: 'Enable': Display URL as goo.gl link - allowing you to track usage via your Google Account. Default is false. 'API': If goo.gl link display is enabled, enter your goo.gl API key. Enable the URL shortener API and find your API key at: http://code.google.com/apis/console/

TweetANewBlacklist.description: Array of pages blacklisted. Example: $wgTweetANewBlacklist = array('BadPage1','BadPage2');

TwoColConflictBetaFeature.description: Make the TwoColConflict feature a BetaFeature. Setting this requires the BetaFeature extension and requires each user to enable the BetaFeature.

TwoColConflictSuggestResolution.description: Suggest an easy resolution for edit conflicts on talk pages when two users replied at the same time.

ULSGeoService.description: ULS can use a geolocation service to suggest languages based on the country the user is vising from. If set to an URL it will query that service which must return an object which has key "country_code" or "country". For example https://api.ipstack.com/check?access_key=yourkey&fields=country_code. Setting this to false will prevent built-in geolocation from being used. You can also provide your own geolocation by assigning such object to window.Geo.

ULSEnable.description: Enable language selection, compact language links, input methods and webfonts for everyone, unless the behavior is overridden by the configuration variables below. Even if false the classes and resource loader modules are registered for the use of other extensions. Language changing via cookie or setlang query parameter is not possible.

ULSAnonCanChangeLanguage.description: Allow anonymous users to change language with cookie and setlang query parameter. Do not use if you are caching anonymous page views without taking cookies into account. Does not have any effect if $wgULSEnable is set to false. @since 2013.04

ULSLanguageDetection.description: Try to use preferred interface language for anonymous users. Do not use if you are caching anonymous page views without taking Accept-Language into account. Does not have any effect if $wgULSEnable is set to false.

ULSIMEEnabled.description: Enable the input methods feature for all users by default. Can be controlled by the user.

ULSWebfontsEnabled.description: Enable the webfonts feature for all users by default. Can be controlled by the user. @since 2014.02

ULSPosition.description: The location and the form of the language selection trigger.  The possible values are: (a) "personal"- as a link near the username or the log in link in the personal toolbar (default). (b) "interlanguage": as an icon near the header of the list of interlanguage  links in the sidebar.

ULSImeSelectors.description: Array of jQuery selectors of elements on which IME should be enabled. @since 2013.11

ULSNoImeSelectors.description: Array of jQuery selectors of elements on which IME must not be enabled. @since 2013.07

ULSNoWebfontsSelectors.description: Array of jQuery selectors of elements on which webfonts must not be applied. By default exclude elements with .autonym because that style set font as Autonym @since 2013.09

ULSFontRepositoryBasePath.description: Base path of ULS font repository. If not set, will be set to 'UniversalLanguageSelector/data/fontrepo/fonts/', relative to $wgExtensionAssetsPath. @since 2013.10

ULSCompactLanguageLinksBetaFeature.description: Set compact interlanguage links as beta feature or not. If set false, compact interlanguage links will be available by default to all users.

ULSCompactLinksPrepend.description: Show these language links on top of the rest in compact language links feature

ULSLanguageSelectorV2SupportedSkins.description: Skins on which the new language selector is used. On any other skin the old language selector is used. Set to an empty array to disable the new language selector everywhere.

UnlinkedWikibaseBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the Wikibase site to use.

UnlinkedWikibaseEntityTTL.description: The cache lifetime (in seconds) for individual entities. Set to null when the UnlinkedWikibaseUpdateEntities script is used to update the data.

UnlinkedWikibaseQueryTTL.description: The cache lifetime (in seconds) for Sparql queries.

UnlinkedWikibaseStatementsParserFunc.description: DEPRECATED: Use UnlinkedWikibaseImitationMode instead. Whether to enable the {{#statements:}} parser function.

UnlinkedWikibaseImitationMode.description: Whether to expose the Lua library as mw.wikibase.*, and enable {{#statements:}} and {{#property:}} parser functions.

UnlinkedWikibaseSitelinkSuffix.description: What sitelink suffix to turn into language links (e.g. 'wiki') or false to disable using language links

UnlinkedWikibaseSitelinkSkippedLangs.description: List of language codes to skip

UploadWizardUseCodeEditor.description: Whether to use CodeEditor as the JSON editor for the Campaign: namespace.

UploadWizardUseCodeMirror.description: Whether to use CodeMirror as the JSON editor for the Campaign: namespace.

UrlShortenerEnableQrCode.description: Enables the QR Code sharing functionality.

UrlShortenerQrCodeShortenLimit.description: If a URL is greater than this length (in bytes), it is first shortened before generating a QR code.

UrlShortenerLegacyTemplate.description: Enable routing of short URLs as previously defined via the legacy ShortUrl extension. Set this to your $wgShortUrlTemplate value, such as '/s/$1'. This registers a Special:ShortUrl page with a read-only resolver to a local 'shorturls' database table, and honors $wgShortUrlTemplate for backwards-compatibility with previously published URLs. Once enabled, the table schema will be owned and maintained by this extension going forward. This flag must be enabled at the same time as disabling the ShortUrl extension (i.e. remove its wfLoadExtension call from LocalSettings.php).

UFEnabledPersonalDataFunctions.description: Set this to an array of personal data functions to enable or empty ([]) to disable all of them. Allowed values: realname, username, useremail, nickname, ip.

UFEnableSpecialContexts.description: Allow to be used in places such as SF form.

UserProtectRestrictionTypes.description: The list of permissions used for per-user per-page access control
