VisualEditorDisableForAnons.description: Do not change the edit tabs/links for anon users, regardless of other settings. Does not affect temporary users. Note that this does not actually disable the visual editor, contrary to the name, and you should probably set the user preferences so that wikitext editor is the default. (T253941)

VisualEditorEnableBetaFeature.description: BetaFeatures integration has been removed. This option allows using the old beta feature preference values ('visualeditor-enable') on wikis where it was previously enabled, until it is migrated (T344762).

VisualEditorEnableVisualSectionEditing.description: When opened from a section edit link, only show that section in the editor (like in the wikitext editor). Can be boolean true for desktop and mobile, or 'mobile' for just mobile.

VisualEditorEnableWikitext.description: Make the wikitext mode of VE available (also called 2017 Wikitext Editor). The corresponding per-user options is visualeditor-newwikitext.

VisualEditorEnableCollabBeta.description: Enable the experimental ve.collab beta feature.

VisualEditorMobileInsertMenu.description: Temporary deployment flag for adding an insert menu on mobile. If true, includes all tools. If an array of strings, includes only the listed tools.

VisualEditorUseChangeTagging.description: Tag edits as having used visualeditor, or VE's wikitext mode.

VisualEditorEditCheckTagging.description: For testing only. Tag edits for the Edit Check project.

VisualEditorEditCheck.description: Enable Edit Check feature. Can also be enabled using ?ecenable=1.

VisualEditorEditCheckABTest.description: A/B test Edit Check for all users. A/B bucket status will override VisualEditorEditCheck. Value is a check name to test.

VisualEditorEnableEditCheckSuggestionsBe.description: Enable the Edit Check Suggestions beta feature.

VisualEditorEditCheckDefaultConfig.description: Override default Edit Check config. Same as editing [[MediaWiki:Editcheck-config.json]].

VisualEditorEditSuggestionCounts.description: PoC (T432733): Server Side Edit Suggestion Counts config. Lives in VisualEditor only for now; the generic LAC cache-warming approach will move to a proper home (TBD) later. URL template placeholders: {wiki_id}/{page_id}/{revision_id}.

VisualEditor.@DefaultUserOptions1: 'visualeditor-enable' is only read when in legacy beta feature mode ('VisualEditorEnableBetaFeature').
VisualEditor.@DefaultUserOptions2: 'visualeditor-betatempdisable' is only read when NOT in beta feature mode.
VisualEditor.@DefaultUserOptions3: 'visualeditor-autodisable' records whether the user has explicitly opted out of VE while it was in beta.

Wp25EasterEggsEnableDefaultState.description: Enable showing the default version of companion on pages that do not have a specific special version of the companion configured for them.

WandaScoreNamespaces.description: Array of namespace IDs where WandaScore should review pages. Default is [0] (main namespace).

WandaScoreAutoReview.description: Whether to automatically review pages on save. Default is true.

WandaScoreShowTile.description: Whether to show the score tile on pages. Default is true.

WandaScoreThresholds.description: Score thresholds for different quality levels. Keys: excellent, good, fair, poor.

WarnNotRecentlyUpdatedDelay.description: Delay after a warning is shown

WarnNotRecentlyUpdatedPages.description: Namespaces, prefixes and message to show

WebChatServer.description: IRC Server to connect to, not required when using the freenodeChat web client.

WebChatClient.description: Which web chat client to use, 'freenodeChat' is required when connecting to freenode, but 'Mibbit' can be used for other networks.

WebDAVCredentialAuthProvider.description: Which of the registered credential auth providers to use

WebDAVHideLockRoot.description: This is if Microsoft Office has issues

WhosOnlinePerWiki.description: If true, only show records related to the current wiki. Set this to false if you run a wiki farm and you'd like to look up results on every wiki and display only one record for one user (the newest).

WhosOnlineShowRealName.description: Show users' real names instead of their on-wiki user names in lists like on the Special:WhosOnline page or API query output?

WhosOnlineTimeout.description: Seconds for how long to store data in cache, i.e. users who have been active within past this many seconds are considered to be online

Wigo3ConfigStoreIPs.description: Store IPs instead of usernames for logged in users too

Wigo3ReplaceNextpoll.description: Replace nextpoll parameter on page save

WikiEditorRealtimePreview.description: Whether to enable the Realtime Preview feature.

WikiEditorRealtimePreviewDebounce.description: Debounce time in milliseconds for the Realtime Preview feature.

WikiEditorRealtimeDisableDuration.description: Average number of milliseconds after which to automatically disable Realtime Preview.

WikiLambdaEnableRepoMode.description: If true, enable the 'repo' mode of WikiLambda that powers Wikifunctions, and so hosting Functions in the main namespace.

WikiLambdaOrchestratorLocation.description: Host and port of the function orchestrator.

WikiLambdaObjectCaches.description: An array of memcached services' configurations to use to store the results of Function calls and the values of ZObjects. If empty, items will instead be stored in the main MediaWiki cache.

WikiLambdaObjectCacheBroadcast.description: A string of the mcrouter route to use for broadcasting cache updates.

WikiLambdaEnableClientMode.description: If true, enable the 'client' mode of WikiLambda, providing the {{#function:…}} parser function to embed calls to Wikifunctions.

WikiLambdaClientModeOffline.description: If true, have the 'client' mode of WikiLambda emit a disabled state and use cached values, but not try to run new Functions calls.

WikiLambdaClientTargetAPI.description: API to target to make function calls (to allow testing against non-standard wikis).

WikiLambdaClientWikis.description: List of client wikis for which the repo wiki will trigger updates.

WikiLambdaClientDefaultShowChanges.description: Whether to show Wikifunctions edits on client wikis by default.

WikiLambdaClientRepoSiteId.description: Global key of the Wikifunctions repo wiki in the sites table (the site_global_key value, e.g. 'wikifunctionswiki', as passed to SiteLookup::getSite() — NOT the per-wiki numeric site_id), used to derive the repo's interwiki prefix for attributing cross-wiki RecentChanges to editors without a local account. Empty disables external-user attribution.

WikiLambdaPersistBackendCache.description: Whether to persist changed objects to backend cache

WikiLambdaEnableAbstractMode.description: If true, enable the 'abstract' mode of WikiLambda that powers Abstract Wikipedia, and so hosting Abstract Wiki content in the relevant namespace(s).

WikiLambdaAbstractNamespaces.description: Map of namespaces to Wikidata concept types to use for Abstract Wiki content.

WikiLambdaEnableAbstractClientMode.description: If true, enable the 'abstract client' mode of WikiLambda that enables integration of Abstract Wikipedia generated articles.

WikiLambdaEnableAbstractClientModeIntegr.description: If true (and WikiLambdaEnableAbstractClientMode is also true), Abstract Wikipedia generated content is rendered in place of opted-in missing local articles. Acts as a kill-switch for the integration behaviour, independent of the rest of abstract client mode.

WikiLambdaAWArticleStoreBackend.description: Storage backend for the Abstract Wikipedia article store. Either 'db' (RDBMS-backed; aw_article_sections on the virtual-awstorage domain) or 'mainstash' (MediaWiki MainStash; durable key/value substrate with TTL cleanup, per T426873).

WikiLambdaAWFragmentStoreBackend.description: Storage backend for the Abstract Wikipedia fragment store. Either 'memcached' (Wikifunctions Memcached instance) or 'mainstash' (MediaWiki MainStash; durable key/value substrate with TTL cleanup, per T432849).

WikiLambdaAbstractWikiArticleStoreTopics.description: Default list of Abstract Wikipedia Topic QIDs to update when the updateAbstractWikiArticleStore.php maintenance script is run without --topics. Overridden by --topics when that option is given.

WikiLambdaAbstractWikiArticleStoreLangs.description: Default list of BCP-47 locale identifiers to update Abstract Wiki Articles for when the updateAbstractWikiArticleStore.php maintenance script is run without --langs. Overridden by --langs when that option is given.

WikiLambdaAbstractWikiIconUrl.description: URL of the Abstract Wikipedia SVG icon uploaded to commons, to use it as decorator in the Abstract Wikipedia notice boxes

WikiLambdaClientFragmentStoreBackend.description: Storage backend for the Wikifunctions Client fragment store. Either 'memcached' (Wikifunctions Memcached instance) or 'mainstash' (MediaWiki MainStash; durable key/value substrate with TTL cleanup, per T432849).

WikiRAGTarget.description: Target to store generated data. Array with 'type' and 'configuration' keys. 'type' is the target type, one of 'WikiRAGTargets' attribute. 'configuration' is an array or JSON string with configuration options for the target type.

WikiRAGPipeline.description: Pipeline of data providers to use for generating data. Array of data provider names, from 'WikiRAGDataProviders' attribute.

WikiRAGApiAllowedIP.description: CIDR to allow access to API

GoogleSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Google Search Console

BingSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Bing Webmaster Center

FacebookAdmins.description: Admin id for Facebook Insights. Multiple ids can be separated by ','

YandexSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Yandex Webmasters

PinterestSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Pinterest Console

NortonSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Norton Safe Web

NaverSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for the Naver Search Engine

BaiduSiteVerificationKey.description: Site verification key for Baidu Search Resource Platform

TwitterSiteHandle.description: Twitter Site handle to add globally

MetadataGenerators.description: Array with metadata generators. Valid values are OpenGraph, Twitter, SchemaOrg, Citation. Defaults to all three generators if empty.

WikiSeoDefaultImage.description: Default image. Local image, if not set $wgLogo will be used.

TwitterCardType.description: Type of twitter card to use. Defaults to 'summary_large_image'. Possible values: 'summary', 'summary_large_image'

WikiSeoDefaultLanguage.description: Language code and area which will set a <link rel='alternate'> for the current page.

WikiSeoDisableLogoFallbackImage.description: Disable setting the sites logo as the default SEO image if no image was provided.

WikiSeoNoindexPageTitles.description: Array of page titles that should have a robot policy of 'noindex'.

WikiSeoEnableAutoDescription.description: Set to true to try to request a description from textextracts, if no description was given, or the description key is set to 'textextracts'.

WikiSeoTryCleanAutoDescription.description: Set to true, if WikiSEO should try to remove dangling sentences when using descriptions from textextracts.

WikiSeoOverwritePageImage.description: Set to true to enable overwriting the image set by extension PageImages

WikiSeoEnableSocialImages.description: Generate dedicated social media icons for pages

WikiSeoSocialImageIcon.description: The icon/watermark to add to the social media image

WikiSeoSocialImageWidth.description: Width of the social media image

WikiSeoSocialImageHeight.description: Height of the social media image

WikiSeoSocialImageTextColor.description: Color of the text on the social image

WikiSeoSocialImageShowAuthor.description: Show the author of the current page revision

WikiSeoSocialImageShowLogo.description: Show the Wiki logo in the top right corner

WikiSeoSocialImageBackgroundColor.description: Default background color if no page image is found

WBCSPrefixSearchProfile.description: Default label scoring profile name, for prefix search. See profiles in config/EntityPrefixSearchProfiles.php

WBCSPrefixSearchProfiles.description: Field weight profiles. These profiles specify relative weights of label fields for different languages, e.g. exact language match vs. fallback language match.

WBCSFulltextSearchProfile.description: Default profile name for fulltext search. See profiles in config/EntitySearchProfiles.php

WBCSInLabelSearchProfile.description: Default profile name for simple entity search by label. See profiles in config/EntityInLabelSearchProfiles.php

WBCSInLabelSearchProfiles.description: Profile definitions for simple entity search by label.

WBCSDefaultPrefixRescoreProfile.description: Default rescore profile for prefix search.

WBCSDefaultFulltextRescoreProfile.description: Default rescore profile for prefix search.

WBCSDefaultInLabelRescoreProfile.description: Default rescore profile for simple entity search by label.

WBCSLanguageSelectorRescoreProfile.description: Default rescore profile to use in the language selector context

WBCSLanguageSelectorPrefixSearchProfile.description: Default query builder profile to use in the language selector context

WBCSLanguageSelectorStatementBoost.description: Type (de)boosts for rescoring functions in the language selector context

WBCSLanguageSelectorRescoreFunctionChain.description: Function chains profiles used by the language selector context

WBCSUseStemming.description: List of languages that we want to have stemming analyzers.

WBCSLicenseMapping.description: Map of licence search strings to wikibase statements.

LexemeLexicalCategoryItemIds.description: Item IDs of Items to suggest as the Lexical Category of a Lexeme. Any Item can be used for the Lexical Category, but the Items listed here will be suggested to editors preferentially.

WbManifestWikidataEntityMapping.description: The mapping of Wikidata entity ids to local Wikibase entity ids.

WbManifestExternalServiceMapping.description: The mapping of external service identifiers to URLs.

MediaInfoProperties.description: Map of { indicative name: property id }. E.g. { depicts: 'P1' }. The key doesn't really matter, except to construct a title (grep for wikibasemediainfo-statements-title-)

MediaInfoHelpUrls.description: Links to pages to learn more about wikibase properties. E.g. { P1: 'https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Commons:Depicts' }

MediaInfoExternalEntitySearchBaseUri.description: URI of the api.php endpoint where entities can be searched.

MediaInfoMediaSearchTitleMatchBaseUri.description: URI of the api.php endpoint where page titles can be searched. The 2-character language code will be sprintf'ed into this value.

MediaInfoSupportedDataTypes.description: List of property datatypes which are supported in the UI

MediaInfoCustomMatchFeature.description: Configuration for the 'custommatch' search feature, see Wikibase\MediaInfo\Search\Feature\CustomMatchFeature for expected format

MediaInfoMediaSearchProfiles.description: Map of { profile key: settings } MediaSearch profiles

WBQualityConstraintsTypeCheckMaxEntities.description: The maximum number of entities that are accessed when checking type or subtype relations.

WBQualityConstraintsCheckDurationInfoSec.description: The maximum time that a single constraint check should usually take, in seconds. Any constraint check that takes longer than this time is logged at ‘info’ level. Specifying `null` disables this logging.

WBQualityConstraintsCheckDurationWarning.description: The maximum time that a single constraint check should ever take, in seconds. Any constraint check that takes longer than this time is logged at ‘warning’ level. Specifying `null` disables this logging.

WBQualityConstraintsCheckOnEntityDuratio.description: The maximum time that a full constraint check on an entity should usually take, in seconds. Any entity constraint check that takes longer than this time is logged at ‘info’ level. Specifying `null` disables this logging.

The maximum time that a full constraint check on an entity should ever take, in seconds. Any entity constraint check that takes longer than this time is logged at ‘warning’ level. Specifying `null` disables this logging.

WBQualityConstraintsEnableConstraintsImp.description: Whether to import property constraint statements into the constraint database or not.

WBQualityConstraintsEnableConstraintsChe.description: Whether to automatically run constraint checks in jobs.
Percentage (0%-100%) of edits that trigger a constraint check

WBQualityConstraintsCheckQualifiers.description: Whether to check constraints on qualifiers.

WBQualityConstraintsCheckReferences.description: Whether to check constraints on references.

WBQualityConstraintsSparqlEndpoint.description: The URL of the primary SPARQL endpoint. Should accept the URL parameters 'query', 'format' and 'maxQueryTimeMillis'. Set to '' (empty string, default) to disable SPARQL functionality.

WBQualityConstraintsAdditionalSparqlEndp.description: The URLs of SPARQL endpoints to query in addition to the primary one. Should accept the URL parameters 'query', 'format' and 'maxQueryTimeMillis'. Set to [] (empty array, default) to only use the primary endpoint.

WBQualityConstraintsSparqlMaxMillis.description: The maximum runtime for queries on the configured SPARQL endpoint, in milliseconds.

WBQualityConstraintsSparqlThrottlingFall.description: The default duration in seconds, which prevents requests to the SPARQL endpoint, if the endpoint response with a 'try-later' (Responsecode 429). This field will only be used, if the endpoint sends a incorrect or incomplete response. The value must be a integer, which is greater than zero.

WBQualityConstraintsSparqlHasWikibaseSup.description: Whether the SPARQL endpoint has special Wikibase support, i. e. whether it is an installation of the Wikibase RDF Query server. If this is enabled, prefixes are not included in SPARQL queries, since the server already defines them by default (which reduces network traffic), and some queries include BlazeGraph-specific query hints. Otherwise, the queries should be suitable for any SPARQL server.

WBQualityConstraintsCheckFormatConstrain.description: Whether or not to check the 'format' constraint. If this flag is set to false, any check of the 'format' constraint will return a 'todo' status with the 'wbqc-violation-message-security-reason' message.

WBQualityConstraintsFormatCacheMapSize.description: Size of the per-regex cache map for format/regex check results. For each regex, up to this many values will have cached whether they match the regex or not, on a least-recently-used basis.

WBQualityConstraintsCacheCheckConstraint.description: Whether to a caching service while running constraint checks. Results are only cached for constraint checks on full entities, and only when the set of constraints to be checked is not specified (i. e. the constraintid parameter is unset).
The time-to-live, in seconds, of cached results of the wbcheckconstraints API action. Ignored if WBQualityConstraintsCacheCheckConstraintsResults is not true.
The maximum number of revision IDs to load when checking whether a cached wbcheckconstraints result is still fresh. Results that depend on more entity IDs than this limit are not cached.

WBQualityConstraintsInstanceOfId.description: The property ID of the 'instance of' property (data type: item), which specifies the class(es) of an item.

WBQualityConstraintsSubclassOfId.description: The property ID of the 'subclass of' property (data type: item), which specifies the superclass(es) of an item.

WBQualityConstraintsPropertyConstraintId.description: The property ID of the 'property constraint' property (data type: item), which specifies the various constraints of a property.

WBQualityConstraintsExceptionToConstrain.description: The property ID of the 'exception to constraint' property (data type: item), which specifies the exceptions of a constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintStatusId.description: The property ID of the 'constraint status' property (data type: item), which specifies the constraint status of a constraint statement. Currently, only one constraint status is known (see WBQualityConstraintsMandatoryConstraintId), and the default status is signified by the absence of a 'constraint status' qualifier.

WBQualityConstraintsMandatoryConstraintI.description: The item ID of the 'mandatory constraint' item, which, when used in a 'constraint status' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the constraint is mandatory and should have no violations except for the known exceptions.

WBQualityConstraintsSuggestionConstraint.description: The item ID of the 'suggestion constraint' item, which, when used in a 'constraint status' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the constraint is merely a suggestion for improvement and violations need not be taken very seriously.

WBQualityConstraintsDistinctValuesConstr.description: The item ID of the 'distinct values constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that all values for this property should differ from each other, or, equivalently, that each value for this property should be unique to one item.

WBQualityConstraintsMultiValueConstraint.description: The item ID of the 'multi-value constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that a property should have more than one value per entity.

WBQualityConstraintsUsedAsQualifierConst.description: The item ID of the 'used as qualifier constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that a property should only be used as a qualifier.

WBQualityConstraintsSingleValueConstrain.description: The item ID of the 'single value constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that a property should have no more than one value per entity.

WBQualityConstraintsSymmetricConstraintI.description: The item ID of the 'symmetric constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that a referenced entity should refer back to the original entity.

WBQualityConstraintsTypeConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'type constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the subject entity should have a certain type, with the relation and type given in the parameters.

WBQualityConstraintsValueTypeConstraintI.description: The item ID of the 'value type constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the referenced entity should have a certain type, with the class and relation given in the parameters.

WBQualityConstraintsInverseConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'inverse constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that a referenced entity should refer back to the original entity with the property given in the parameters.

WBQualityConstraintsItemRequiresClaimCon.description: The item ID of the 'item requires claim constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that an entity with a given statement should also have certain other statements.

WBQualityConstraintsValueRequiresClaimCo.description: The item ID of the 'value requires claim constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the target/value entity of a given statement should have certain statements.

WBQualityConstraintsConflictsWithConstra.description: The item ID of the 'conflicts-with constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that an entity with a given statement should not have certain other statements.

WBQualityConstraintsOneOfConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'one-of constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should be one of a given set of values.

WBQualityConstraintsMandatoryQualifierCo.description: The item ID of the 'mandatory qualifier' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates a given statement should have the given qualifier.

WBQualityConstraintsAllowedQualifiersCon.description: The item ID of the 'allowed qualifiers constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates a given statement should only have the given qualifiers.

WBQualityConstraintsRangeConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'range constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should be within a given range.

WBQualityConstraintsDifferenceWithinRang.description: The item ID of the 'difference within range constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the difference value of a given statement and of another given statement should be within a given range.

WBQualityConstraintsCommonsLinkConstrain.description: The item ID of the 'commons link constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should be a valid link to Wikimedia Commons.

WBQualityConstraintsContemporaryConstrai.description: The item ID of the 'contemporary constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the entities which are linked through this property should be contemporary according to their start and end time values.

WBQualityConstraintsFormatConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'format constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should conform to a given pattern.

WBQualityConstraintsUsedForValuesOnlyCon.description: The item ID of the 'used for values only constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used for the main value of a statement, not for qualifiers or references.

WBQualityConstraintsUsedAsReferenceConst.description: The item ID of the 'used as reference constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used for references, not for the main value of a statement or for qualifiers.

WBQualityConstraintsNoBoundsConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'no bounds constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used with no bounded quantity as its value.

WBQualityConstraintsAllowedUnitsConstrai.description: The item ID for the 'allowed units constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should only have certain units.

WBQualityConstraintsSingleBestValueConst.description: The item ID for the 'single best value constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should have a single, distinguished best value per item.

WBQualityConstraintsAllowedEntityTypesCo.description: The item ID for the 'allowed entity types constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property can be used only in certain entity types (e.g. only items).

WBQualityConstraintsCitationNeededConstr.description: The item ID of the 'citation needed constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should have at least one reference for its values.

WBQualityConstraintsPropertyScopeConstra.description: The item ID of the 'property scope constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used in some locations (main value, qualifiers, and/or references, but not all of them).

WBQualityConstraintsLexemeLanguageConstr.description: The item ID of the 'lexeme language constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used in lexeme that have the given language set.

WBQualityConstraintsLabelInLanguageConst.description: The item ID of the 'label in language constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the property should only be used in entities that have label in the given languages.

WBQualityConstraintsLanguagePropertyId.description: The property ID of the 'Wikimedia language code' property (data type: string), which specifies the language code of a 'label in language' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsClassId.description: The property ID of the 'class' property (data type: item), which specifies the class/type of a 'type' or 'value type' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsRelationId.description: The property ID of the 'relation' property (data type: item), which specifies the relation ('instance of' or 'subclass of') of a 'type' or 'value type' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsInstanceOfRelationId.description: The item ID of the 'instance of' item, which, when used in a 'relation' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the 'type' or 'value type' constraint defined in this statement demands an 'instance' relation.

WBQualityConstraintsSubclassOfRelationId.description: The item ID of the 'subclass of' item, which, when used in a 'relation' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the 'type' or 'value type' constraint defined in this statement demands a 'subclass' relation.

WBQualityConstraintsInstanceOrSubclassOf.description: The item ID of the 'instance or subclass of' item, which, when used in a 'relation' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the 'type' or 'value type' constraint defined in this statement demands a 'instance or subclass' relation.

WBQualityConstraintsPropertyId.description: The property ID of the 'property' property (data type: property), which specifies the property parameter of an 'inverse', 'item requires claim', 'value requires claim', 'difference within range', 'mandatory qualifiers', or 'qualifiers' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsQualifierOfPropertyC.description: The property ID of the 'qualifier of property constraint' property (data type: item), which specifies the item parameter of an 'item requires claim', 'value requires claim', or 'one of' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsMinimumQuantityId.description: The property ID of the 'minimum quantity' property (data type: quantity), which specifies the minimum quantity parameter of a 'range' or 'diff within range' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsMaximumQuantityId.description: The property ID of the 'maximum quantity' property (data type: quantity), which specifies the maximum quantity parameter of a 'range' or 'diff within range' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsMinimumDateId.description: The property ID of the 'minimum date' property (data type: point in time), which specifies the minimum date parameter of a 'range' or 'diff within range' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsMaximumDateId.description: The property ID of the 'maximum date' property (data type: point in time), which specifies the maximum date parameter of a 'range' or 'diff within range' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsNamespaceId.description: The property ID of the 'namespace' property (data type: string), which specifies the namespace parameter of a 'commons link' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsFormatAsARegularExpr.description: The property ID of the 'format as a regular expression' property (data type: string), which specifies the format parameter of a 'format' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsSyntaxClarificationI.description: The property ID of the 'syntax clarification' property (data type: monolingual text), which specifies human-readable explanations of a 'format' constraint. The syntax clarification is shown as part of the 'format' constraint violation message, clarifying the regular expression.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintClarificat.description: The property ID of the 'constraint clarification' property (data type: monolingual text), which specifies human-readable explanations of a constraint (of any constraint type). The constraint clarification is shown below the main constraint violation message.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintScopeId.description: The property ID of the 'constraint scope' property (data type: item), which specifies the context(s) in which a constraint is checked.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintEntityType.description: The property ID of the property (data type: item) which specifies the entity types on which a constraint is checked. By default, this is the same as the 'constraint scope' property, but may also be set to a different one. The recognized values (items representing entity types) are the same as for the 'allowed entity types' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsSeparatorId.description: The property ID of the 'separator' property (data type: property), which specifies the allowed separator(s) for “single value” and “single best value” constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintCheckedOnM.description: The item ID of the 'constraint checked on main value' item, which, when used in a 'constraint scope' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the constraint should be checked on the main snak of a statement.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintCheckedOnQ.description: The item ID of the 'constraint checked on qualifiers' item, which, when used in a 'constraint scope' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the constraint should be checked on the qualifier snaks of a statement.

WBQualityConstraintsConstraintCheckedOnR.description: The item ID of the 'constraint checked on references' item, which, when used in a 'constraint scope' qualifier of a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the constraint should be checked on the reference snaks of a statement.

WBQualityConstraintsNoneOfConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'none-of constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should not be one of a given set of values.

WBQualityConstraintsIntegerConstraintId.description: The item ID of the 'integer constraint' item, which, when used in a 'property constraint' statement on a property, indicates that the value of a given statement should have only integer values.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibaseItemId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase item' item, which represents the 'item' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibasePropertyId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase property' item, which represents the 'property' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibaseLexemeId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase lexeme' item, which represents the 'lexeme' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibaseFormId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase form' item, which represents the 'form' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibaseSenseId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase sense' item, which represents the 'sense' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsWikibaseMediaInfoId.description: The item ID of the 'wikibase MediaInfo' item, which represents the 'mediainfo' entity type for 'allowed entity types' constraints.

WBQualityConstraintsPropertyScopeId.description: The property ID of the 'property scope' property, which specifies the scope parameter of a 'scope' constraint.

WBQualityConstraintsAsMainValueId.description: The item ID of the 'as main value' item, which, when used in a 'property scope' parameter of a 'scope' constraint, signifies that a property may be used for the main snaks of statements.

WBQualityConstraintsAsQualifiersId.description: The item ID of the 'as qualifiers' item, which, when used in a 'property scope' parameter of a 'scope' constraint, signifies that a property may be used for qualifiers of statements.

WBQualityConstraintsAsReferencesId.description: The item ID of the 'as references' item, which, when used in a 'property scope' parameter of a 'scope' constraint, signifies that a property may be used for references of statements.

WBQualityConstraintsPropertiesWithViolat.description: Property IDs of statements whose qualifiers are expected to violate constraints, and where constraints checks are therefore skipped, as if the subject entity was an exception to the constraints defined on the qualifier properties.

WBQualityConstraintsStartTimePropertyIds.description: Property IDs of statements whose minimum value defines the start time of an entity, which is used by 'contemporary' contraints.

WBQualityConstraintsEndTimePropertyIds.description: Property IDs of statements whose maximum value defines the end time of an entity, which is used by 'contemporary' contraints.

WBQualityConstraintsYearUnit.description: The unit used for a quantity that represents a difference between two dates, in years. Note that for entity units, the full concept URI must be used, not just the entity ID.

WBQualityConstraintsSecondUnit.description: The unit used for a quantity that represents a difference between two dates, in seconds. Note that for entity units, the full concept URI must be used, not just the entity ID.

WBQualityConstraintsEnableSuggestionCons.description: Whether to enable the 'constraint suggestion' constraint status or not. This is a temporary configuration that will be removed once constraint suggestions are permanently enabled on Wikidata.

WBQualityConstraintsFormatCheckerShellbo.description: Float value between 0 and 1 determining ratio of requests made to shellbox (vs. WDQS) in FormatChecker in evaluating regexes. Zero disables requesting to shellbox (all going to WDQS) and one means all requests will go to shellbox.

WBQualityConstraintsFormatCheckerKnownGo.description: An array of known-good regex patterns that can be checked directly, without using Shellbox. These regexes should be immune to ReDoS attacks.

WikimediaAntiAbuseEnablePersonalInfoFlag.description: Enables Echo notifications, sent to opted-in users with the viewsuppressed or suppressrevision right, when the mw-private-personal-info tag is applied to a revision. Requires the Echo extension.

WikimediaAntiAbuseCoPEModelConfig.description: Configuration for the CoPE model used for content policy evaluation. Needs to be filled out with the appropriate URL and host. The timeout is optional and when non-empty will be used as the timeout for requests to the CoPE model.

WikimediaAntiAbuseDeveloperMode.description: If developer mode is enabled. This should be set to false in production. Developer mode can affect whether e.g. SSL certification validation is enabled in HTTP requests

WikimediaCampaignEventsFluxxOauthUrl.description: Oauth URL for the Fluxx API

WikimediaCampaignEventsFluxxBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Fluxx API

WikimediaCampaignEventsFluxxClientID.description: Client ID to use for the Fluxx API.

WikimediaCampaignEventsFluxxClientSecret.description: Client secret to use for the Fluxx API.

WikimediaCampaignEventsSparqlEndpoint.description: The URL of the primary SPARQL endpoint.

WMCBadEmailDomainsFile.description: Path to the file listing the banned domains, one domain name per line.

WMCEmailAuthEnforce.description: Whether to enforce email auth verification. Default is false, so log-only mode.

WMCPrivilegedGroups.description: List of local groups which should be considered privileged. This is used for some security checks, mainly logging.

WMCPrivilegedGlobalGroups.description: List of global groups which should be considered privileged. This is used for some security checks, mainly logging.

WMCPrivilegedPasswordPolicy.description: Password policy applying to users in privileged groups.

WMCGlobalGroupToRateLimitClass.description: Map of global group names to the rate limit class ('rlc') assigned to members of that group in JWTs.

WMCAttributionBrandmarkUrl.description: URL to the site's brand sound

WMCDiscord.description: Configuration for the Discord preview generation service.

WMCDiscordPreviewEnabled.description: Whether to serve the Discord preview REST endpoint. Disabled by default; enable it per wiki through site configuration. Turning it off again disables the endpoint immediately, without a code deploy.

WMCNoReferrerDomains.description: List of external link domains that should get rel="noreferrer noopener", so the browser omits the Referer header when following the link. Subdomains match. See T429090.

WMESchemaVisualEditorFeatureUseSamplingR.description: The default sampling rate for the VisualEditorFeatureUse instruments. This should only ever differ from the rate above when that is set to 1. See https://phabricator.wikimedia.org/T312016 for detail.

DTSchemaEditAttemptStepSamplingRate.description: Rate at which to sample DiscussionTools sessions for instrumentation; overrides the rate above if set to any number other than 0

DTSchemaEditAttemptStepOversample.description: Oversample EditAttemptStep logging for DiscussionTools sessions; distinct from rate tuning, as it'll flag the events as being oversampled

WMEVectorPrefDiffSalt.description: @var string Used as a salt in VectorPrefDiffInstrumentation to hash the user id. Set this in `wmf-config/PrivateSettings`.

WMEWikimediaDebugBackend.description: Debug server to use in WikimediaDebug cookies (false to disable the feature).

WMENewPHPVersion.description: The php version we're moving to.

WMENewPHPSamplingRate.description: The sampling rate of all users we want to direct to the new PHP version.

WMEGeoIP2Path.description: The path to the GeoIP2 country database file. For Wikimedia production, suggested value is '/usr/share/GeoIP/GeoIP2-Country.mmdb'. Null means that we make no attempt to use GeoIP2 to look up country codes for an IP address.

WikimediaEventsIPReputationAccountAgeThr.description: Number (in days) to use as a cut off for recording IP reputation data on edits. User accounts older than this number of days will not be included in logging of IP reputation data on edit.

WikimediaEventsCreateAccountInstrumentat.description: Whether to submit server-side instrumentation events for post-account creation pageviews. Default is false.

WikimediaEventsUserLoginInstrumentation.description: Whether to submit server-side instrumentation events for Special:UserLogin form submissions (JS vs no-JS classification). Default is false.

WikimediaEventsExternalLinkInstrumentati.description: Whether to submit instrumentation events for external link clicks. Default is false.

WikimediaEventsExternalLinkTrackedDomain.description: List of domains for which to submit instrumentation events for external link clicks. It matches the domain and all subdomains. Default is empty list. Example value: ["example.com", "example.org"]

WikimediaStylesSkins.description: Define skins that should get Wikimedia styles. This currently corresponds to skins that support the night (dark mode) theme.

WikimediaMessagesLicensing.description: Style of licensing messages to display, one of 'standard', 'commons', 'mediawiki', 'wikidata', 'wikinews', 'wikifunctions'

WikimediaMessagesAnonDonateLink.description: Move the donate link for anonymous users from the menu sidebar to login/account creation area

WikimediaMessagesHasLiquidThreadsLogs.description: Whether a wiki has logs from the LiquidThreads extension. Used to determine if the LiquidThreads log type should be added by WikimediaMessages if that extension is undeployed

WikisourceHttpProxy.description: HTTP proxy URL to use for requests to external APIs.

WikispeechSpeechoidUrl.description: The URL to use for the Speechoid service.

The URL to use for the Speechoid service queue.

is great than number of connections in queue,

not being able to synthesize new speech, or similar.
Default number of seconds to await an HTTP response from Speechoid.
Falsy value defaults to MediaWiki default.

WikispeechListenMaximumInputCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters in the input (a segment) sent to the Speechoid service.

description: Map of HTML tags that should be removed completely, i.e.
including any content. Keys are tag names and the values
determine whether a tag should be removed, as follows:
* If true, remove all tags of that type.
* If an array, remove tags whose class matches any of the

strings in the array.
* If false, tags of that type will
not be removed. This can be used in ''LocalSetting.php'' to
override default criteria.
HTML tags that will break text in segments. This ensure that,
for example a header text without punctuation suffix will not
be merged to the same segment as the text content of a
preceding paragraph.
List of the [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Namespaces namespace]
indices, for which Wikispeech is activated.
Shortcuts for Wikispeech commands. Each shortcut defines the
key pressed (as key code<ref>https://www.cambiaresearch.com/articles/15/javascript-char-codes-key-codes</ref>)
and any modifier keys (ctrl, alt or shift).
If an utterance has played longer than this (in seconds),
skipping back will rewind to the start of the current
utterance, instead of skipping to previous utterance.
Help page for Wikispeech. If defined, a button that takes the
user here is added next to the player buttons.
Feedback page for Wikispeech. If defined, a button that takes
the user here is added next to the player buttons.
The selector for the element that contains the text of the page.
Used internally, but may change with MediaWiki version.
Registered voices per language.
System default voice falls back on the first registered voice for a language
if not defined by Speechoid.
Available speech rate options for Wikispeech.
Values are numeric speech rates, and will be converted to percentage.
Minimum number of minutes between queuing jobs that
automatically flushes expired utterances from the utterance store.
The job will be queued during creation of a new utterance,
given that enough minutes has passed since the previous queuing of the job.
Disable automatic flushing by setting value to a falsy value (0, false, null, etc).
To avoid running the flush job too often, see the MW job documentation:
https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Job_queue#Job_execution_on_page_requests
Minimum number of days for an utterance to live before being
automatically flushed from the utterance store.
More or less the cache flush setting for synthesized text.
Setting this value too low will save disk space but cause frequently
requested text segments to be re-synthesized more often with a CPU cost.
Setting this value too high will block improvements to the voice synthesis.
Setting this value to 0 will in effect turn off the cache
and thus flush all utterances as soon as possible.
FileBackend group defined in LocalSettings.php used for utterance audio and metadata files.
If not defined in LocalSettings.php, a FSBackend will be created that work against
a temporary directory. See log warnings for exact path.

WikispeechUtteranceFileBackendContainerN.description: Container name used in FileBackend for utterance audio and metadata files.

description: In case of the file backend is Swift and this value is set true,
the Wikispeech will set the 'X-Delete-After' header when creating files in Swift
and the utterance flushing mechanism will not invoke delete command in Swift.
I.e. the actual flushing of utterances is moved to the Swift layer.
In order for this to make sense, the Swift file backend must be set to accept
these headers. For more information on how to do this see
https://docs.openstack.org/swift/latest/overview_expiring_objects.html
This feature will be officially supported by Wikispeech as of
the first LTS release of MediaWiki after 1.35 (i.e. probably 1.39).
Controls how the pronunciation lexicon is persisted and accessed.
'Speechoid' must be a part of the chain in order to make an impact to the speech synthesis.
Possible values are:
'Speechoid', access only the underlying lexicon in Speechoid. No revision history.
'Wiki+Speechoid', access the lexicon stored as articles in NS_PRONUNCIATION_LEXICON for revision history and passed down to Speechoid.
'Wiki', access only the lexicon stored as articles in NS_PRONUNCIATION_LEXICON.
'Cache', transient storage in MediaWiki WAN cache. For development only.
'Cache+Speechoid', transient storage in WAN cache, passed down to Speechoid. For development only.
Run Wikispeech in producer mode. This allows other
wikis (consumers) to use this wiki to generate
utterances. When an API requests includes the
parameter `consumer-url`, page content is retrieved
from the consumer wiki on that URL.

WikispeechListenDoJournalMetrics.description: Whether or not to log usage metrics for TTS API

the edit lexicon page and is not logged in.

leads to the edit lexicon page on the producer wiki.
Mainly for development testing. When true, utterances are flushed when the page is loaded
and removes all utterances for all voices, which helps when testing Speechoid utterance generation.

WikispeechReportPronunciationUrl.description: API endpoint to wiki for pronunciation error reporting.

WikispeechUseTextFilters.description: Use filters that change the segment text before it's sent to Speechoid. Can be used to fix expressions (not individual words) that aren't handled properly

WikistoriesMinFrames.description: Minimum number of frames a story needs to have to be valid.

WikistoriesMaxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames a story needs to have to be valid.

WikistoriesMaxTextLength.description: Maximum number of characters a story frame can have.

WikistoriesUnmodifiedTextThreshold.description: Percentage threshold of unmodified text allowed before showing final edit warning

WikistoriesDiscoveryMode.description: Defines how is the discovery module activated. 'beta' means it is a beta feature. 'public' means it is available by default to everyone, including anons. Any other value means the discovery feature is disabled.

WikistoriesNotifyAboutStoryMaintenance.description: Send notifications to story watchers when stories need to be updated.

WikistoriesCommonsDomain.description: Sets the Commons API domain. Defaults to production value, use 'commons.wikimedia.beta.wmflabs.org' for beta cluster

WikistoriesRestDomain.description: Sets the REST API domain. Defaults to null, in which case the domain of the current site will be used. Otherwise use 'wikipedia.org' for full article text when running locally

WikistoriesTermsOfUseUrl.description: URL to the terms of use page

WikistoriesCCBYSAUrl.description: URL to the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported license

WikistoriesGFDLUrl.description: URL to the GNU Free Documentation License

ExampleWelcomeColorDays.description: Color for the Welcome message bar by week day

ExampleWelcomeColorDefault.description: Default color for the Welcome message

ExampleMyWord.description: Value for the {{MYWORD}} magic word in wikitext.

DLPMaxQueryTime.description: Maximum allowed time for database queries in milliseconds.

DLPQueryCacheTime.description: This is the query cache. It can help with situations where you have a template with the same query used on a large number of pages all being refreshed at once. The query cache cannot be purged. Suggested value between 30 to 600.
